http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:443
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:3306
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:6379
http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io:27017

description.zh: 逐条请求 sslip.io 通配域名并记录解析与响应；成功时域名解析到嵌入 IP 并返回对应服务内容。
description.en: Request each sslip.io wildcard domain and record resolution and responses; the domain resolving to the embedded IP with the service content returned confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 已独立查询 sslip.io 的 A/AAAA 与 TTL，不沿用 nip.io 的行为假设。
prerequisites.en: Query sslip.io A or AAAA records and TTL independently rather than assuming nip.io behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境有一个对应嵌入 IP 的无敏感标记服务，可区分服务器请求和本地浏览器请求。
prerequisites.en: An isolated environment has a nonsensitive marker service at the embedded IP and can distinguish server requests from local browser requests.

analysis.zh: 阳性需 sslip.io 域名通过输入检查后解析并由服务端 socket 连接标记目标。DNS 记录存在、URL 被保存、响应状态变化或开发者浏览器访问都不能证明服务端 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an sslip.io hostname to pass input checks, resolve, and be connected by the server-side socket to the marker. DNS existence, URL storage, status changes, or developer-browser access do not prove server-side SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认服务端连接后停止，不测试该列表中的云元数据路径或其他真实内部服务。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first confirmed server connection and do not test the list's cloud metadata paths or other real internal services.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 DNS 缓存，关闭内部标记端口，并从代理和应用日志中移除唯一令牌。
opsecTips.en: Flush test DNS caches, close the internal marker port, and remove the unique token from proxy and application logs.

name.zh: sslip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用 sslip.io 的嵌入 IP 主机名解析到回环、元数据和私网地址，验证 DNS 后地址分类。
description.en: Uses sslip.io hostnames with embedded IPs that resolve to loopback, metadata, and private addresses to test post-DNS classification.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: sslip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标覆盖通配域名场景：针对与 nip.io 独立的 sslip.io 服务，验证嵌入 IP 主机名解析到回环、元数据与私网地址时 DNS 后地址分类是否缺失。验证维度涵盖解析行为单独记录与受控回环端口对照请求。
overview.en: sslip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets covers wildcard domains: for the sslip.io service independent of nip.io, verify whether embedded-IP hostnames resolving to loopback, metadata, and private addresses expose missing post-DNS address classification. Verification dimensions cover recording resolution behavior separately and controlled loopback-port comparison requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把 DNS 名视为安全而不检查其解析地址，攻击者可用通配 DNS 把合法外观主机绑定到内部目标；sslip.io 的缓存、TTL 与 IPv4 嵌入规则独立于其他公共服务，需单独记录解析行为。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application treating a DNS name as safe without checking its resolved addresses, letting wildcard DNS bind legitimate-looking hosts to internal targets; sslip.io's caching, TTLs, and IPv4 embedding rules are independent of other public services and must be recorded separately.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先查询 127.0.0.1.sslip.io、169.254.169.254.sslip.io 等域名的当前解析结果并留存 TTL；再选择一个受控回环端口，用唯一请求令牌比较原始主机、解析 IP 与实际连接目标；最终 socket 与受控服务访问日志一致显示内部目标即确认成立。只得到 DNS A 记录不是证据。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first queries current resolutions for domains like 127.0.0.1.sslip.io and 169.254.169.254.sslip.io, retaining TTLs; then pick a controlled loopback port and compare the original host, resolved IP, and actual connection target using a unique request token — the final socket and controlled service log both showing the internal target confirms. A DNS A record alone is not evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 解析后阻断回环、私网和链路本地地址，固定允许目的地，限制 DNS 重解析和出站网络，并重检重定向。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：通配域名目标被拒绝，合法功能保留。
mitigation.en: Block loopback, private, and link-local addresses after resolution, pin allowed destinations, limit DNS re-resolution and egress networking, and recheck redirects. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: wildcard-domain targets denied, legitimate function preserved.

title.zh: 伪装公网域名访问链路本地

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io；域名看似公网站点实际解析到链路本地地址，返回元数据即白名单逻辑被击穿。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io; a public-looking domain resolving link-local and returning metadata defeats allowlist logic.

title.en: Cover the intranet with dash syntax

description.zh: 改用 10-0-0-1.sslip.io 等横线编码写法覆盖更多内网目标；命中响应即扩充内网资产清单。
description.en: Switch to dash forms like 10-0-0-1.sslip.io to cover more internal targets; each hit grows the intranet asset list.

title.zh: 收割临时凭证进入云账号
title.en: Harvest keys to enter the cloud account

description.zh: 请求 iam/security-credentials 角色路径；取到临时凭证并配入云 CLI 即接管实例角色对应的云资源。
description.en: Request the iam/security-credentials role path; loading the temporary keys into the cloud CLI takes over the role's resources.

review.rationale: sslip.io 域名是 SSRF DNS 解析绕过 Payload。

description.zh: 绕过对点分 sslip.io 形式特征的匹配：短横线写法等价解析；内网设备页面返回即成功。
description.en: Use the dash notation that resolves identically past dotted-form signatures; an internal device page returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制 IP 段的规则：十六进制形式同样被通配解析；目标端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Use hex forms still matched by the wildcard against decimal-range rules; distinguishable target port responses confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对紧凑十进制匹配：补零形式解析等价；网关管理页可达即成功。
description.en: Use zero-padded forms that resolve identically against compact decimal matching; a reachable gateway admin page confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 当前 1u.ms 对点分地址与十六进制标签的解析已通过独立 DNS 工具核对。
prerequisites.en: Verify current 1u.ms handling of dotted addresses and hexadecimal labels with an independent DNS tool.

prerequisites.zh: 使用一个受控目标地址，且可观察服务端校验值、DNS 答案和最终连接三者。
prerequisites.en: Use one controlled target address and observe the server's validated value, DNS answer, and final connection.

analysis.zh: 阳性是编码外观域名通过字符串校验，但解析结果属于禁止网段并被应用连接。域名格式包含十六进制、DNS 返回 NXDOMAIN/多地址、或离线换算出内网 IP而没有 socket 连接都属假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a domain-looking encoded host passing string validation, resolving into a blocked range, and being connected by the application. Hex-looking labels, NXDOMAIN or multiple answers, or offline conversion without a socket connection are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个编码域名到达受控服务后停止，不对六个样例逐个打真实地址。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one encoded hostname reaches the controlled service; do not send all six samples to real addresses.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DNS 查询记录中的内部地址，清除解析/连接缓存并关闭标记监听器。
opsecTips.en: Remove internal addresses from test DNS records, clear resolver and connection caches, and close the marker listener.

name.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用 1u.ms 通配符 DNS 服务的 make-<点分IP>-rr 记录格式（如 make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms 解析为 127.0.0.1），验证主机字符串检查是否忽略最终 DNS 目标。
description.en: Uses the 1u.ms wildcard DNS service's make-<dotted-ip>-rr record format (e.g. make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms resolving to 127.0.0.1) to test whether hostname checks ignore the final DNS destination.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标覆盖编码地址通配 DNS 场景：针对按域名文本过滤的取回功能，验证 make-<点分IP>-rr.1u.ms 记录格式能否把回环、链路本地与 RFC1918 地址藏于域名后。验证维度涵盖六条编码域名的独立解析与受控标记请求。
overview.en: 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets covers encoded-address wildcard DNS: for fetchers filtering on domain text, verify whether the make-<dotted-IP>-rr.1u.ms record format hides loopback, link-local, and RFC1918 addresses behind domain names. Verification dimensions cover independent resolution of six encoded domains and controlled marker requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器按域名文本允许请求，HTTP 客户端随后使用 DNS 返回的受阻地址，校验对象和连接对象不一致；外部服务行为可能变化，需先独立解析并留存 TTL 再依赖结论。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a filter allowing requests by domain text while the HTTP client then uses the blocked address DNS returns, splitting the validated object from the connection object; third-party service behavior can change, so resolve independently and retain TTLs before drawing conclusions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先在测试解析器中查询 make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms 等六个主机并记录解析结果与 TTL；再只挑一个解析到受控标记服务的样例由应用请求，记录 DNS、连接与请求令牌；解析后地址与受控服务日志双重一致即确认缺口。域名格式看似编码 IP、解析超时或 NXDOMAIN 都不能确认。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first queries the six hosts like make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms in a test resolver, recording answers and TTLs; then pick one sample resolving to a controlled marker service, have the application request it, and record DNS, connection, and request token — dual agreement between the resolved address and the controlled service log confirms the gap. Name formats that merely look like encoded IPs, resolution timeouts, or NXDOMAIN do not confirm. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 不要依赖域名外观，解析全部结果并做二进制地址分类；固定允许地址并通过出站代理阻断内网和元数据。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：编码域名目标被拒绝，合法域名保留。
mitigation.en: Never rely on domain appearance: resolve all answers and classify addresses in binary form; pin allowed addresses and block intranet and metadata via an egress proxy. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: encoded-domain targets denied, legitimate names preserved.

description.zh: 提交 http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms；后缀 rr 触发轮询解析，命中 127.0.0.1 即该域名等价回环地址。
description.en: Submit http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms; the rr suffix triggers round-robin resolution and hitting 127.0.0.1 makes the domain a loopback alias.

attackChain.payload:
http://make-127-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-169-254-169-254-rr.1u.ms
http://make-192-168-1-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-10-0-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-172-16-0-1-rr.1u.ms
http://make-0-0-0-0-rr.1u.ms

title.zh: 利用 rr 双址回连外带
title.en: Use the rr pair for callbacks

description.zh: 域名交替解析攻击者 IP 与回环地址；外带回连与内网探测共用同一域名，取证侧只见正常的解析记录与流量。
description.en: The domain alternates between the attacker IP and loopback; callbacks and intranet probes share one domain, leaving only normal-looking resolutions behind.

title.zh: 替换编码段打击元数据

description.zh: 把 127-0-0-1 段替换为 169-254-169-254 编码重新提交；直连云元数据拖取角色凭证即完成攻击升级。
description.en: Swap the 127-0-0-1 segment for 169-254-169-254 and resubmit; reaching cloud metadata and pulling role keys escalates the attack.

review.rationale: 域名携带的编码地址用于 SSRF 目标绕过，仍是 Payload。

description.zh: 绕过对单一 make 前缀模式的检测：一条域名在两地址间轮转解析；两次请求命中不同目标即成功。
description.en: Rotate resolution between two addresses within one domain past single-prefix detection; two requests hitting different targets confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制短横线形式的规则：十六进制构造同样被解析；回环/元数据内容返回即成功。
description.en: Build targets hexadecimally, still parsed by the service, against dash-decimal rules; loopback or metadata content returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对域名整体形态的判断：userinfo 段伪装成 CDN 域名，实际主机仍为 1u.ms；目标解析并连接成功即成功。
description.en: Disguise a decoy CDN in userinfo while the real host stays 1u.ms; successful target resolution and connection confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过按主机名黑名单的判定：同一通配域名下用端口区分内网服务；端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Distinguish internal services by port under one wildcard hostname past hostname blacklists; distinguishable port responses confirm success.

wafBypass.command: http://rebind6.{LAB_OAST}/  # 仅 AAAA 记录: 第一次 ::ffff 外部, 第二次 内部 v6

description.zh: 绕过只审计 A 记录解析的规则：用 AAAA 记录做 IPv6 侧重绑定；两次请求源地址变化即成功。
description.en: Perform v6-side rebinding via AAAA-only records against A-record auditing; source addresses changing across requests confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对最终内网 IP 的直接特征匹配：经 CNAME 链条间接到达内网目标；网关页面返回即成功。
description.en: Reach the internal target through a CNAME cascade against direct-IP matching; a gateway page returning confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for DNS Rebinding Hostname Testing

description.zh: 逐条解析重绑定服务域名并记录解析与连接行为；成功时确认各服务是否可解析，且 127-0-0-1 系列域名应解析到回环地址。
description.en: Resolve each rebinding-service domain and record resolution and connection behavior; confirming which services resolve, with the 127-0-0-1 series resolving to loopback, confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 localtest.me 当前解析到回环地址，并记录测试主机的 hosts/DNS 覆盖情况。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that localtest.me currently resolves to loopback and record any hosts or DNS overrides on the test machine.

prerequisites.zh: 仅开放一个本地标记端口，并能证明请求由后端 URL 获取器而不是操作者浏览器发送。
prerequisites.en: Open only one local marker port and prove that requests come from the backend URL fetcher rather than the operator's browser.

analysis.zh: 阳性是仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的规则允许 localtest.me，随后后端连接回环标记服务。DNS 回环解析本身、关闭端口的错误差异、或前端预览请求都不构成服务端访问。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a localhost-string rule allowing localtest.me followed by a backend connection to the loopback marker. Loopback DNS resolution alone, errors from a closed port, or a frontend preview request does not constitute server-side access.

opsecTips.zh: 标记端口收到一次后端请求即停止，不继续尝试列表中的数据库端口。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the marker port receives one backend request and do not continue to the listed database ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭本地服务，清理 DNS 与应用 URL 缓存，并删除测试令牌和回环访问日志。
opsecTips.en: Close the local service, clear DNS and application URL caches, and delete test tokens and loopback access logs.

name.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用解析到回环地址的 localtest.me 搭配服务端口，验证只拒绝 localhost 字符串的 SSRF 防护。
description.en: Uses localtest.me, which resolves to loopback, with service ports to test SSRF controls that reject only the localhost string.

subCategory.zh: 回环与内网探测

overview.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测覆盖回环别名域名场景：针对仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的 SSRF 防护，验证解析到 127.0.0.1 的 localtest.me 搭配 8080/3306/6379 端口能否绕过检查命中本机服务。验证维度为一个域名、三个端口变体的对照验证。
overview.en: localtest.me Loopback-Domain SSRF Probe covers loopback-alias domains: against SSRF protection that only rejects the localhost string, verify whether localtest.me — resolving to 127.0.0.1 — with ports 8080/3306/6379 bypasses checks to reach local services. Verification dimensions compare one domain across three port variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是安全规则仅匹配 localhost 或 127.0.0.1 字符串而未解析其他域名，任何指向回环的公共域名都可绕过字符串规则；应用应按解析后 IP 判断安全性，而非按域名文本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is safety rules matching only the localhost or 127.0.0.1 string without resolving other names, so any public domain pointing at loopback bypasses string rules; safety must be judged by the resolved IP, not the domain text.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先离线确认 localtest.me 解析到 127.0.0.1；再选择一个受控本地端口和一个关闭端口作对照，由应用各请求一次并记录连接；本地标记服务收到应用请求且连接地址为回环即确认字符串规则缺口。DNS 解析、端口错误差异或浏览器自行请求都不够。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first confirms offline that localtest.me resolves to 127.0.0.1; then pick one controlled local port and one closed port as controls, requesting each once via the application and recording connections — the local marker service receiving the application request with a loopback connection address confirms the string-rule gap. DNS resolution, port-error differences, or browser-initiated requests are insufficient. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对所有 DNS 结果进行地址分类并阻断回环，不为域名字符串设例外；使用出站允许列表限制端口和目标。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：回环别名域名被拒绝，合法目标保留。
mitigation.en: Classify all DNS results by address and block loopback with no exceptions for domain strings; restrict ports and targets via an egress allowlist. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: loopback-alias domains denied, legitimate targets preserved.

title.zh: 借保留域名探测本机端口
title.en: Probe local ports via a reserved domain

description.zh: 提交 http://localtest.me:8080；该域名固定解析 127.0.0.1，返回服务响应即借合法域名探测本机端口成功。
description.en: Submit http://localtest.me:8080; the domain always resolves to 127.0.0.1, so a service response means local port probing through a legit-looking name.

title.zh: 保持域名替换端口扫描
title.en: Sweep ports under the same domain

description.zh: 域名保持不变依次替换 80、3306、6379 等端口提交；按错误形态与耗时差异推断本机开放的服务。
description.en: Keep the domain and rotate ports 80, 3306, 6379; error shapes and latency differences infer which local services are open.

title.zh: 衔接协议载荷推进利用

description.zh: 对确认存活的服务改投 gopher、dict 等协议载荷继续交互；拿到服务回显即把探测推进到命令执行阶段。
description.en: Aim gopher and dict payloads at the confirmed-live services; service output pushes the probe into the code-execution stage.

review.rationale: localtest.me URL 是解析后回环 SSRF 探针。

description.zh: 绕过对回环别名域名的端口形态限制：直接携带内部路径探测；元数据或服务响应返回即成功。
description.en: Carry internal paths on the loopback alias past port-form assumptions; metadata or service responses returning confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写无尾点域名的精确匹配：大小写与尾点均不影响解析；端口指纹差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Mutate case and append the trailing dot without affecting resolution; distinguishable port fingerprints confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过仅覆盖 IPv4 别名的规则：改用系统 IPv6 本机别名解析；服务可达即成功。
description.en: Resolve via the system IPv6 localhost alias against IPv4-only coverage; the service being reachable confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有测试域配置可审计的低 TTL/交替 A 记录，不依赖示例 `rebind.attacker.com`。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned test domain with auditable low-TTL or alternating A records rather than the placeholder `rebind.attacker.com`.

prerequisites.zh: 受控外部和回环标记服务共享唯一请求令牌，且可观察校验、重试和连接的 DNS 查询序列。
prerequisites.en: Controlled external and loopback markers share a unique request token, and DNS lookups during validation, retry, and connection are observable.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求首次校验得到允许的外部地址，后续同一请求重新解析为回环并连接标记服务。TTL=0、多次查询、地址顺序变化或客户端固定首答而未访问内部端都不是利用。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires validation to receive an allowed external address and a later resolution for the same request to return loopback and reach the marker. TTL zero, repeated queries, answer reordering, or a client pinning the first answer without internal access is not exploitation.

opsecTips.zh: 首次观察检查时/使用时地址切换并到达回环后停止，不切换到元数据或私网数据库。
opsecTips.en: Stop at the first validation-to-use address switch reaching loopback; do not switch to metadata or private databases.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复测试 DNS 区的固定记录，等待缓存过期，关闭两端标记服务并删除唯一令牌。
opsecTips.en: Restore a fixed DNS record in the test zone, wait for caches to expire, shut down both marker services, and delete the unique token.

name.zh: 低 TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用低 TTL 或交替应答域名测试校验阶段与连接阶段是否发生不同 DNS 解析。
description.en: Uses low-TTL or alternating-answer hostnames to test whether validation and connection perform different DNS resolutions.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: 低 TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF 探测覆盖 DNS TOCTOU 场景：针对校验与连接分离的取回功能，验证低 TTL 或交替应答域名能否让两次解析返回不同结果并命中内网。验证维度涵盖可审计交替 DNS 区配置与多端口变体验证。
overview.en: Low-TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF Probe covers the DNS TOCTOU scenario: for fetchers separating validation from connection, verify whether low-TTL or alternating-answer domains make two resolutions return different results and hit intranets. Verification dimensions cover auditable alternating DNS zone configuration and multi-port variant validation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用先解析并允许外部 IP，连接或重试时重新解析得到内部 IP，低 TTL 与未固定地址形成检查时/使用时竞态；rebind 占位域名必须替换为授权者控制的 DNS，时序需明确首答外部、后答内部。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application resolving and allowing the external IP first, then re-resolving to an internal IP on connect or retry — low TTL plus unpinned addresses create a check-time/use-time race; the rebind placeholder domain must be replaced with DNS under the authorizer's control, with timing that answers external first and internal later.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离 DNS 区配置可审计的交替 A 记录（首答外部、次答内部）；再由应用逐条请求 rebind 域名的各端口变体，用受控外部与回环标记服务记录查询序列、TTL 和最终连接；DNS 权威日志证明两次答案不同且内部标记服务收到同一请求令牌即确认窗口成立。低 TTL 本身不构成利用。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 configures auditable alternating A records in an isolated DNS zone (external first, internal second); then have the application request each port variant of the rebind domain, recording query sequences, TTLs, and final connections against controlled external and loopback marker services — authoritative DNS logs proving two different answers plus the internal marker service receiving the same request token confirm the window. Low TTL alone is not exploitation. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 解析并固定已允许 IP，连接到固定地址并保持正确 Host/SNI；限制重新解析，重试和重定向必须重新执行完整地址策略。修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归：两次解析不一致时连接被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Resolve and pin the approved IP, connect to the fixed address with correct Host/SNI; restrict re-resolution and re-run the full address policy on retries and redirects. After the fix, regress with the same positive, negative, and normal samples: connections denied when the two resolutions disagree.

title.zh: 自建低 TTL 重绑定域名

description.zh: 提交 http://rebind.{LAB_OAST}；己方权威 DNS 对该域 TTL 置 0 并交替应答，首轮解析到攻击者 IP 供校验通过。
description.en: Submit http://rebind.{LAB_OAST}; your authoritative DNS answers with TTL 0 and alternates, the first lookup hitting the attacker IP to pass checks.

title.zh: 触发二次解析翻转地址
title.en: Flip the address on the second lookup

description.zh: 服务端校验通过后立即发起取值请求；解析翻转到 127.0.0.1 即连接已指向内网，防护留档的仍是首跳攻击者地址。
description.en: The server fetches right after validating; the resolution flipping to 127.0.0.1 points the connection inward while defenses logged the first hop.

description.zh: 微调权威 DNS 应答序列控制翻转时机，稳定复现后把域名指向任意内网目标重打；重绑定通道即可规模化复用。
description.en: Tune the answer sequence to control the flip; once stable, repoint the domain at any internal target and the rebind channel scales.

review.rationale: 低 TTL/交替应答是 SSRF 的 DNS Rebinding Payload 模型。

wafBypass.command: http://rebind.{LAB_OAST}/  # A 记录: 外网IP + 内网IP 各一条

description.zh: 绕过对单条 A 记录缓存的有效性检查：多条记录轮询使两次连接命中不同地址；外部校验请求与内部请求均出现即成功。
description.en: Publish two A records so round-robin lands successive connections on different addresses; both an external validation hit and an internal request confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对单端口探测的判定：不同端口分别触发解析时机差；一端口先出网校验另一端口命中内网即成功。
description.en: Probe different ports to shift resolution timing; one port validating out-of-band first while another hits the internal target confirms success.

wafBypass.command: nslookup rebind.{LAB_OAST}  # TTL=0，两次查询返回 127.0.0.1 与外部IP 交替

description.zh: 绕过 HTTP 层的出网记录：仅用 DNS 查询验证低 TTL 翻转行为；两次应答 IP 不同即重绑定能力成立。
description.en: Validate the low-TTL flip through DNS queries alone; alternating answers across two queries confirm rebinding capability.

prerequisites.zh: 已按行确认 0-8 是 iframe/fetch 浏览器代码，9-10 是 DNS 配置占位，11-12 是服务端 URL。
prerequisites.en: Confirm by line that indexes 0-8 are iframe or fetch browser code, 9-10 are DNS configuration placeholders, and 11-12 are server-side URLs.

prerequisites.zh: 浏览器同源测试、权威 DNS 区和服务端 SSRF 测试使用彼此隔离的标记与日志。
prerequisites.en: Browser same-origin testing, the authoritative DNS zone, and server-side SSRF testing use isolated markers and logs.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 Payload/Tool 卡已存在，且 commandRouting 对 13 行全覆盖且无重叠。
prerequisites.en: Destination payload and tool cards exist, and commandRouting covers all 13 lines without overlap.

analysis.zh: split 的阳性边界不可互换：浏览器行需证明同源上下文中的脚本访问，DNS 行只证明配置/解析，服务端 URL 需证明后端出站连接。iframe 加载失败、CORS 阻止读取、DNS 指向内网或服务器未请求 URL 都不能跨类别推导成功。
analysis.en: Positive boundaries for the split are not interchangeable: browser lines require script access in an origin context, DNS lines prove only configuration or resolution, and server URLs require backend egress. Failed iframe loads, CORS-blocked reads, internal DNS answers, or a server not requesting the URL cannot imply success across categories.

opsecTips.zh: 每个执行主体取得一个最小证据后停止；禁止让浏览器脚本读取元数据正文或让服务端访问真实内网。
opsecTips.en: Stop each execution principal after one minimal proof; do not let browser scripts read metadata bodies or let the server access real internal networks.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 iframe/script 页面和 DNS 记录，清空浏览器/DNS/HTTP 缓存，并核对 13 行已迁移且原混合入口移除。
opsecTips.en: Delete test iframe or script pages and DNS records, clear browser, DNS, and HTTP caches, and verify all 13 lines were routed and the mixed source entry was removed.

name.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding 与 SSRF 混合集（待拆分）
name.en: Mixed Browser DNS-Rebinding and SSRF Corpus (Split Required)

description.zh: 混合 iframe、fetch 脚本、DNS 配置主机名和通配 DNS URL，客户端同源攻击与服务端 SSRF 不能共用一条攻击链。
description.en: Mixes iframe and fetch scripts, DNS configuration hostnames, and wildcard-DNS URLs, so browser same-origin attacks and server-side SSRF cannot share one attack chain.

subCategory.zh: 浏览器与服务端 Rebinding 拆分

overview.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding 与 SSRF 混合集（待拆分）用于0-8 行是浏览器 HTML/JavaScript，9-10 行是 DNS 区配置占位，11-12 行才是服务端 URL；执行主体和证据不同。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Mixed Browser DNS-Rebinding and SSRF Corpus (Split Required) is intended for this boundary: Lines 0-8 are browser HTML or JavaScript, 9-10 are DNS-zone placeholders, and 11-12 are server-side URLs, with different execution principals and evidence. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 浏览器攻击依赖同源与 DNS 缓存变化，服务端 SSRF 依赖 URL 获取器；把二者合并会错误地将浏览器请求当成服务器请求。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Browser attacks depend on origin and DNS-cache changes while SSRF depends on a server URL fetcher; combining them wrongly attributes browser traffic to the server. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 按索引把 iframe/fetch 路由到 DNS Rebinding Payload，把域名配置迁 DNS 工具卡，把两个通配 URL 路由到 SSRF 绕过卡。 浏览器侧需同源和 DevTools/服务日志，DNS 配置需权威解析记录，SSRF 需服务端出站和目标日志；三类证据不可互换。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Route iframe and fetch lines to DNS-rebinding payloads, DNS placeholders to the DNS tool card, and the two wildcard URLs to the SSRF-bypass card. Browser cases require origin and browser or service logs, DNS configuration requires authoritative lookup records, and SSRF requires server egress and target logs; evidence is not interchangeable. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 浏览器服务校验 Host/Origin 并采用网络隔离，服务端获取器解析后阻断内网；DNS 工具配置使用独立测试域并清理记录。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Browser-facing services should validate Host and Origin and use network isolation, while server fetchers block internal ranges after resolution; DNS tests use and clean an isolated zone. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

title.zh: 确认浏览器与服务端 Rebinding 拆分适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Browser and Server-Side Rebinding Split boundary

description.zh: 0-8 行是浏览器 HTML/JavaScript，9-10 行是 DNS 区配置占位，11-12 行才是服务端 URL；执行主体和证据不同。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: Lines 0-8 are browser HTML or JavaScript, 9-10 are DNS-zone placeholders, and 11-12 are server-side URLs, with different execution principals and evidence. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控浏览器与服务端 Rebinding 拆分样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Browser and Server-Side Rebinding Split case

description.zh: 按索引把 iframe/fetch 路由到 DNS Rebinding Payload，把域名配置迁 DNS 工具卡，把两个通配 URL 路由到 SSRF 绕过卡。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Route iframe and fetch lines to DNS-rebinding payloads, DNS placeholders to the DNS tool card, and the two wildcard URLs to the SSRF-bypass card. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对浏览器与服务端 Rebinding 拆分证据
title.en: Verify Browser and Server-Side Rebinding Split evidence

description.zh: 浏览器侧需同源和 DevTools/服务日志，DNS 配置需权威解析记录，SSRF 需服务端出站和目标日志；三类证据不可互换。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Browser cases require origin and browser or service logs, DNS configuration requires authoritative lookup records, and SSRF requires server egress and target logs; evidence is not interchangeable. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归浏览器与服务端 Rebinding 拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Browser and Server-Side Rebinding Split

description.zh: 浏览器服务校验 Host/Origin 并采用网络隔离，服务端获取器解析后阻断内网；DNS 工具配置使用独立测试域并清理记录。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Browser-facing services should validate Host and Origin and use network isolation, while server fetchers block internal ranges after resolution; DNS tests use and clean an isolated zone. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

review.rationale: 浏览器代码、DNS 配置和服务端 URL 属于三个执行主体，必须按行拆分到 Payload/Tool。
